Ropedia W0: Scaling Loco-Manipulation World Models across Embodiments with Human Experience WorldModel

world foundation model loco-manipulation cross-embodiment teleoperation humanoid

简要说明：Ropedia W0 提出了首个以自我为中心的运动-操作世界基础模型，利用 1 万小时人类数据和 3 千小时机器人数据进行训练，通过统一运动学表示跨实体建模运动与操作，在多个基准上达到 SOTA，并支持实时 VR 交互。

TLDR: Ropedia W0 introduces the first egocentric loco-manipulation world foundation model trained on 10k hours of human and 3k hours of robot data, unifying locomotion and manipulation across embodiments via a shared kinematic representation, and achieving SOTA on multiple benchmarks with real-time distilled rollouts.

Abstract: World models enable embodied agents to anticipate action consequences, yet jointly modeling locomotion and manipulation across diverse embodiments remains challenging due to heterogeneous action spaces and limited multimodal supervision. We present Ropedia W0, the first egocentric loco-manipulation world foundation model spanning humans and robots with diverse embodiments. We curate Xp-Data, comprising 10k hours of egocentric human data and 3k hours of robot data with unified multimodal annotations and systematic quality control. A unified kinematic representation encodes locomotion through camera poses and manipulation through projected skeletons, with robot skeletons combining embodiment-specific forward kinematics with extensive manual keypoint annotation and correction. We also introduce Xp-Teleop, a long-horizon loco-manipulation benchmark based on high-quality dexterous humanoid teleoperation data. Evaluations demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across five cross-embodiment benchmarks (DreamDojo, $Ψ_0$, $ω$-HOME, Xp-Teleop, and AgiBot) and on held-out human egocentric video, from zero-shot inference to few-shot and full-data post-training. Scaling human pre-training data improves performance on both human and robot evaluations. After distillation, our model supports real-time, minute-long rollouts, enabling live VR interaction. Applications in policy evaluation, model-based planning, and world-action modeling further demonstrate the model's utility for embodied decision-making.

摘要（中文）：世界模型使具身智能体能够预判行为后果，然而，由于异构动作空间和多模态监督数据的稀缺，跨不同具身形态联合建模移动与操控仍具挑战。我们提出了Ropedia W0，这是首个覆盖人类及多种具身形态机器人的以自我为中心的移动-操控世界基础模型。我们构建了Xp-Data数据集，包含10,000小时以自我为中心的人类数据和3,000小时机器人数据，具备统一的多模态标注和系统性质量控制。一种统一的运动学表示通过相机位姿编码移动行为，通过投影骨架编码操控行为，其中机器人骨架将具身特定的正向运动学与大规模人工关键点标注及修正相结合。我们还引入了Xp-Teleop，一个基于高质量灵巧人形遥操作数据的长时程移动-操控基准。评估结果表明，在五个跨具身形态基准（DreamDojo、$Ψ_0$、$ω$-HOME、Xp-Teleop和AgiBot）以及留出的人类自我中心视频上，从零样本推理到少样本和全数据后训练，均取得了最先进的性能。扩展人类预训练数据可同时提升人类和机器人评估的性能。经过蒸馏后，我们的模型支持实时的、分钟级的长时程生成，实现实时VR交互。在策略评估、基于模型的规划以及世界-动作建模中的应用进一步展示了该模型在具身决策中的实用价值。

Authors: Tianqi Liu, Hanfei Zhao, Qifeng Liang, Hui En Pang, Jiarui Xu, Sayang Mu, Penghao Qiu, YingSheng Zhang, Jun Wang, Ziang Cao, Mingze Sun, Yukang Cao, Fangzhou Hong, Zhaoxi Chen, Ziwei Liu

HAF-VLA: Hierarchical Action Flow Framework for Humanoid Vision-Language-Action Control VLA

hierarchical action flow humanoid loco-manipulation flow-matching KV cache conditioning whole-body action space

简要说明：HAF-VLA 提出了一种分层动作流框架，通过阶段嵌入、跨阶段KV缓存条件和渐进去噪，将预训练VLA模型适配到人形机器人全身移动操作，并在真实世界任务中提升了性能。

TLDR: HAF-VLA introduces a hierarchical action-flow framework that adapts pretrained VLA models to humanoid whole-body loco-manipulation via stage embeddings, cross-stage KV-cache conditioning, and progressive denoising, improving real-world tasks.

Abstract: Humanoid robots hold great promise as general-purpose agents in human-centered environments, yet adapting generalist vision-language-action (VLA) policies to real-world humanoid loco-manipulation remains challenging. Unlike fixed-base or wheeled manipulators, humanoids must coordinate locomotion, posture, gaze, and dual-arm manipulation over a high-dimensional whole-body action space, where inaccurate base or waist motions can easily induce unstable and aggressive upper-body compensation. We propose HAF-VLA, a hierarchical action-flow framework for humanoid VLA control. Built upon a pretrained flow-matching VLA, HAF-VLA inherits the vision-language prefix encoder and action expert weights, and adapts them to humanoid whole-body loco-manipulation with learnable stage embeddings and cross-stage KV-cache conditioning. Instead of generating the full action chunk in a single pass, HAF-VLA progressively denoises a shared whole-body action space: first locomotion and head commands, then waist refinement, and finally full-body manipulation. To preserve structural dependencies across stages, we introduce a cross-stage KV cache conditioning mechanism, enabling subsequent action generation stages to refine and augment their outputs based on the action representations from preceding stages. Experimental results across six real-world tasks demonstrate that our framework significantly enhances the performance of existing models in humanoid loco-manipulation tasks, demonstrating an effective pathway for adapting strong mobile-manipulation VLAs to humanoid whole-body loco-manipulation.

摘要（中文）：人形机器人在以人为中心的环境中作为通用智能体展现出巨大潜力，然而将通用视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略适配到真实世界的人形移动操作任务仍然面临挑战。与固定基座或轮式机械臂不同，人形机器人需要在高维全身动作空间中协调运动、姿态、视线和双臂操作，其中不精确的基座或腰部运动极易引发不稳定且激烈的手臂补偿行为。我们提出HAF-VLA，一种面向人形机器人VLA控制的分层动作流框架。基于预训练的流匹配VLA，HAF-VLA继承了视觉-语言前缀编码器和动作专家权重，并通过可学习的阶段嵌入和跨阶段KV缓存条件机制将其适配到人形全身移动操作任务。HAF-VLA并非一次性生成完整动作块，而是逐步去噪共享的全身动作空间：首先生成运动与头部指令，然后是腰部细化，最后生成全身操作动作。为保持各阶段之间的结构依赖关系，我们引入跨阶段KV缓存条件机制，使后续动作生成阶段能够基于前序阶段的动作表示对其输出进行细化和增强。跨六个真实世界任务的实验结果表明，我们的框架显著提升了现有模型在人形移动操作任务中的性能，为将强大的移动操作VLA适配到人形全身移动操作提供了一条有效路径。

Authors: Langzhe Gu, Chengkai Hou, Meng Li, Xinhua Wang, Xinyuan Lv, Shuanghao Bai, Guangrun Li, Jingyang He, Ziluo Ding, Zhiyuan Xu, Ning Ding, Kuan Cheng, Jian Tang, Shanghang Zhang, Zhengping Che

FR-VLA: Implicit Force Reasoning VLA for Contact-Rich Manipulation VLA

force reasoning contact-rich manipulation Vision-Language-Action model force query tokens force admission signal

简要说明：FR-VLA提出了一种视觉-语言力推理模型，通过从视觉-语言上下文学习力准入信号来调节VLA动作生成中的力输入，从而提升真实机器人上的接触丰富操作性能。

TLDR: FR-VLA introduces a Vision-Language Force-Reasoning Model that learns a force admission signal from visual-language context to modulate force input in VLA action generation, improving contact-rich manipulation on real robots.

Abstract: Integrating force awareness into Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models involves not merely encoding wrench measurements as an additional modality, but determining when and how strongly physical interaction should influence robot action generation. Existing VLAs that use force typically inject it through a fixed pathway, without explicitly determining when it is relevant to the current action. This calls for an intermediate force relevance mechanism inside the VLA, in which visual-language context estimates the relevance of physical feedback to the current task before force enters the action pathway. FR-VLA addresses this gap with a Vision-Language Force-Reasoning Model that uses learnable force query tokens to derive a force admission signal grounded in visual-language context, and uses this signal to modulate an external tokenized force pathway for action generation. In real-world experiments on five contact-rich tasks across two robotic platforms, FR-VLA achieves the highest mean success rate over six evaluated stages, and trajectory visualizations show that its force admission varies with the interaction phase.

摘要（中文）：将力觉感知融入视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，不仅涉及将力/力矩测量作为额外模态进行编码，更关键的是确定物理交互应在何时以及以何种强度影响机器人动作生成。现有使用力信息的VLA模型通常通过固定路径注入力数据，并未显式判断该信息与当前动作的相关性。这要求在VLA内部建立一种中间力相关性机制，使视觉-语言上下文在力信息进入动作路径之前，先评估物理反馈与当前任务的相关性。FR-VLA通过引入视觉-语言力推理模型解决了这一空白，该模型利用可学习的力查询令牌，基于视觉-语言上下文推导出力接纳信号，并以此信号调制外部令牌化力路径，用于动作生成。在两个机器人平台的五项接触密集任务真实世界实验中，FR-VLA在六个评估阶段中取得了最高平均成功率，轨迹可视化结果表明其力接纳程度随交互阶段动态变化。

Authors: Jiaju He, Zhiyuan Yang, Ruyang Han, Jiahong Tang, Zhiping Lin, Haiyue Zhu

CondenseVLA: Learnable History Condensation for Efficient Multi-Frame VLA VLA

history condensation multi-frame VLA cross-attention slot tokens robot manipulation

简要说明：CondenseVLA 提出了一种可学习的解码端历史浓缩模块，通过交叉注意力和辅助正则化将缓存的视觉特征蒸馏为固定数量的槽令牌，从而提升记忆依赖的机器人操作成功率（Simpler-WidowX、LIBERO、真实世界和RMBench）。

TLDR: CondenseVLA introduces a learnable decoder-side history condensation module for multi-frame Vision-Language-Action models, distilling cached visual features into a fixed set of slot tokens via cross-attention and auxiliary regularization, improving memory-dependent manipulation success on Simpler-WidowX, LIBERO, real-world, and RMBench benchmarks.

Abstract: Robot manipulation often depends on short-term cues - such as brief contacts, temporary occlusions, and intermediate object states - that are ambiguous in a single frame and can only be resolved by integrating observations over time. However, injecting historical information solely by enlarging the history window is computationally costly and frequently yields limited gains due to substantial redundancy and task-agnostic, inflexible sampling of observations. We propose CondenseVLA, a multi-frame VLA policy with a learnable decoder-side history condensation module for using short-term visual context in action decoding. Given a sequence of cached per-frame features from the VLM backbone, CondenseVLA distills observation history into a fixed set of slot tokens using learnable queries and multi-head cross-attention. Simple auxiliary regularization penalizes overlap among slot attention maps and decorrelates slot embeddings, encouraging complementary attention and reducing slot redundancy. Across the evaluated tasks, CondenseVLA improves Simpler-WidowX success from 58.7% to 69.8% (+11.1 percentage points), achieves 97.2% on LIBERO, and reaches 52.8% on real-world tasks. It achieves 21.6% success on memory-dependent RMBench tasks. These results support selective condensation of bounded recent visual evidence for action decoding, while harder multi-observation tasks expose the limits of a finite history window. Project page: https://github.com/FeiyangHong/CondenseVLA

摘要（中文）：机器人操控往往依赖于短期线索——例如短暂的接触、暂时的遮挡以及中间物体状态——这些线索在单帧中具有模糊性，唯有通过跨时间的观测整合才能加以解析。然而，仅通过扩大历史窗口来注入历史信息，计算成本高昂，且由于观测存在大量冗余以及任务无关、不灵活的采样方式，其增益往往十分有限。我们提出CondenseVLA，一种多帧VLA策略，配备可学习的解码端历史信息压缩模块，用于在动作解码中利用短期视觉上下文。给定来自VLM骨干网络的缓存逐帧特征序列，CondenseVLA通过可学习查询和多头交叉注意力，将观测历史蒸馏为一组固定数量的槽位令牌。简单的辅助正则化方法对槽位注意力图之间的重叠施加惩罚，并对槽位嵌入进行去相关，从而促进互补性注意力并减少槽位冗余。在评估的所有任务中，CondenseVLA将Simpler-WidowX的成功率从58.7%提升至69.8%（提升11.1个百分点），在LIBERO上达到97.2%，在真实世界任务中达到52.8%。在依赖记忆的RMBench任务上，其成功率达到21.6%。这些结果支持对有限的近期视觉证据进行选择性压缩以用于动作解码，同时，更难的多观测任务也揭示了有限历史窗口的局限性。项目页面：https://github.com/FeiyangHong/CondenseVLA

Authors: Feiyang Hong, Yujie Wei, Bo Zhao, Xiu Su, Hongxun Yao, Shuo Yang

Long-Horizon Multi-Object Rearrangement via Distilled Tree Search over Continuous Actions Manipulation

Monte Carlo Tree Search policy-value model long-horizon manipulation multi-object rearrangement sim-to-real

简要说明：DISCO将渐进式扩展的蒙特卡洛树搜索与学习到的策略和价值网络结合，在物理仿真中生成长期规划，并将搜索产生的计划蒸馏到策略-价值模型中，在仿真和真实世界的多目标重排任务上优于基线方法。

TLDR: DISCO combines progressive-widening MCTS with learned policy and value networks in physics simulation, distilling search-derived plans into a policy-value model for long-horizon multi-object rearrangement, achieving superior performance over baselines in simulated and real-world tasks.

Abstract: Despite recent advances in policy learning, long-horizon manipulation remains difficult because learned policies must avoid compounding errors while preserving future feasibility. While search-based planning can explicitly reason over such future consequences, it quickly becomes expensive in high-dimensional continuous action spaces. This raises a central question: how can long-horizon reasoning from search be transferred into policies in continuous action spaces? To this end, we propose DISCO: Distilled Tree Search over Continuous Actions. DISCO uses progressive-widening MCTS in physics simulation to generate long-horizon plans. During search, a learned policy proposes continuous actions, while a learned value function scores actions by their expected progress toward task completion. Using GPU-parallelized simulation, DISCO periodically distills MCTS-generated plans into the policy-value model, improving the action proposals and value estimates used in subsequent searches. Finally, the learned policy-value model can be directly deployed without the need for simulator-based search at test time. Across simulated and real-world rearrangement tasks, DISCO outperforms behavior cloning, reinforcement learning, and search-based baselines.

摘要（中文）：尽管策略学习近期取得了进展，但长程操作仍然困难重重，因为学习到的策略必须避免累积误差，同时保持未来可行性。虽然基于搜索的规划能够显式推理此类未来后果，但在高维连续动作空间中，其计算代价迅速变得高昂。这引出了一个核心问题：如何将搜索中的长程推理迁移到连续动作空间中的策略中？为此，我们提出了DISCO：连续动作上的蒸馏树搜索。DISCO利用物理仿真中的渐进加宽蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）生成长程规划。在搜索过程中，学习到的策略提出连续动作，而学习到的价值函数则根据动作对任务完成预期进展的贡献对其进行评分。借助GPU并行仿真，DISCO定期将MCTS生成的规划蒸馏到策略-价值模型中，从而改进后续搜索中使用的动作提议和价值估计。最终，学习到的策略-价值模型可直接部署，无需在测试时依赖基于仿真的搜索。在模拟和真实世界的重排任务中，DISCO均优于行为克隆、强化学习以及基于搜索的基线方法。

Authors: Kallol Saha, Yining Hong, Amber Li, Yejin Choi, Maxim Likhachev, David Held

SWAP: Test-Time Steerable Humanoid Whole-Body Collision Avoidance HumanoidEmbodied

whole-body collision avoidance diffusion policy reinforcement learning test-time steering humanoid robot

简要说明：SWAP提出了一个用于人形机器人全身避碰的分层框架，结合高层扩散策略生成多模态运动与低层强化学习控制器维持稳定，并在仿真和真实Unitree G1机器人上实现测试时引导以定制行为。

TLDR: SWAP introduces a hierarchical framework for humanoid whole-body collision avoidance, combining a high-level diffusion policy for multimodal motion generation with a low-level RL controller for stabilization, and enables test-time steering via cost-guided sampling in simulation and on a real Unitree G1 robot.

Abstract: Humanoid robots operating in human-centric environments must coordinate the entire body to traverse tight, cluttered spaces while maintaining balance. Existing methods often struggle to jointly consider dynamic stability and collision avoidance from high-dimensional perceptual inputs. Moreover, for humanoids, safe behavior is inherently multimodal: the same obstacle may admit multiple valid traversals, which is difficult to represent with a single deterministic policy. To address these challenges, we propose SWAP (Steerable Whole-body Avoidance Policy), a hierarchical framework that separates collision-aware decision making from stabilization. A high-level, perception-conditioned diffusion policy generates multimodal, collision-aware motion proposals, while a low-level whole-body RL controller tracks these proposals and maintains dynamic balance. To efficiently train the high-level policy, we obtain scalable supervision via hindsight labeling: we roll out the low-level policy under randomized commands, place obstacles only in the space that each executed motion did not sweep, so the motion is collision-free by construction, and re-render the perception the robot would have seen. At deployment, Monte Carlo sampling with simple cost signals steers the diffusion model toward safe, task-aligned behaviors without heavy reward tuning. Experiments in simulation and on a real Unitree G1 humanoid show reliable avoidance with static and dynamic obstacles. Test-time steering further enables customization, improving targeted rewards (e.g., speed, orientation, or posture) by 34% on average while maintaining a high collision avoidance rate. Together, these results support a practical solution to humanoid whole-body collision avoidance with test-time steerability. Project website: https://iscoyizj.github.io/SWAP-steerable-humanoid-oa-website/

摘要（中文）：摘要： 在以人为本的环境中操作的人形机器人必须协调全身动作，以在狭窄、杂乱的空间中穿行并保持平衡。现有方法通常难以从高维感知输入中联合考虑动态稳定性与碰撞避免。此外，对于人形机器人而言，安全行为本质上是多模态的：同一障碍物可能存在多种有效的通行方式，而单一确定性策略难以表征这种多样性。为解决上述挑战，我们提出了SWAP（可操控全身避碰策略），一种将碰撞感知决策与稳定控制分离的层级框架。高层策略采用基于感知条件的扩散策略，生成多模态、碰撞感知的运动提案；低层策略则通过全身强化学习控制器跟踪这些提案并维持动态平衡。为高效训练高层策略，我们通过事后标注获得可扩展的监督信号：在随机指令下 rollout 低层策略，仅在执行运动未扫掠的空间中放置障碍物，从而使该运动在构造上保证无碰撞，并重新渲染机器人本应看到的感知信息。在部署阶段，通过蒙特卡洛采样结合简单代价信号，引导扩散模型朝向安全且符合任务目标的行为，而无需繁重的奖励调参。在仿真和真实 Unitree G1 人形机器人上的实验表明，该方法能够可靠地避开静态与动态障碍物。测试时引导进一步支持行为定制，在保持高避碰率的同时，目标奖励（如速度、朝向或姿态）平均提升34%。上述结果共同支撑了一种兼具测试时可操控性的实用化人形机器人全身避碰解决方案。项目网站：https://iscoyizj.github.io/SWAP-steerable-humanoid-oa-website/

Authors: Zeji Yi, Guanqi He, Xiaofeng Guo, Guannan Qu, Pieter Abbeel, Yan Duan, Karen Liu, Guanya Shi

Physical Words: A Vocabulary for Structuring Latent Reasoning in Robot Manipulation VLA

Physical Words latent reasoning robot manipulation visuotactile long-horizon

简要说明：PhysWord 提出了物理词汇，以原子动作动词作为潜在推理的语义锚点，在 UniVTAC、LIBERO-Long 以及真实双臂/灵巧手任务上取得了最先进成果。

TLDR: PhysWord introduces Physical Words, atomic action verbs serving as semantic anchors for latent reasoning in robot manipulation, achieving state-of-the-art success on UniVTAC, LIBERO-Long, and real-world bimanual/dexterous tasks.

Abstract: Multimodal reasoning provides robotic foundation models with predictive context needed for reliable action generation. However, language-based reasoning captures task semantics but struggles to express fine-grained physical dynamics, while latent reasoning models future state evolution but offers limited structure for organizing these dynamics into reusable reasoning primitives. To bridge this gap, we introduce PhysWord, a reasoning-before-acting foundation model built on Physical Words, which use atomic action verbs as shared semantic anchors for continuous representations of physical dynamics. Specifically, PhysWord predicts upcoming atomic action words and directly aligns their contextual hidden states with latent targets derived from the corresponding future observations. Building on these primitives, we construct a temporally structured PhysWord space with visual and optional tactile variants of each action word. Autoregressively predicting Physical Words across future timesteps captures transitions between execution stages, providing structured multimodal context for action generation. PhysWord achieves state-of-the-art success rates of 90.3\% on visuotactile UniVTAC and 99.6\% on vision-based LIBERO-Long, and outperforms competing methods on real-world tasks using bimanual grippers and dexterous hands. Further evaluations demonstrate that our structured latent reasoning framework generalizes to unseen scenarios and enables long-horizon manipulation.

摘要（中文）：多模态推理为机器人基础模型提供了生成可靠动作所需的预测性上下文。然而，基于语言的推理虽能捕捉任务语义，却难以表达细粒度的物理动力学；而潜在推理虽可预测未来状态演化，但缺乏足够的结构来将这些动力学组织为可复用的推理原语。为弥合这一鸿沟，我们提出了PhysWord——一种基于“物理词汇”（Physical Words）构建的“先推理后行动”基础模型。物理词汇以原子动作动词作为连续物理动力学表征的共享语义锚点。具体而言，PhysWord预测即将发生的原子动作词，并将其上下文隐藏状态直接与由对应未来观测导出的潜在目标对齐。基于这些原语，我们构建了一个具有时间结构的PhysWord空间，其中每个动作词均包含视觉及可选触觉变体。跨未来时间步自回归地预测物理词汇，可捕捉执行阶段之间的转换，从而为动作生成提供结构化的多模态上下文。PhysWord在视觉触觉数据集UniVTAC上达到了90.3%的最新成功率，在基于视觉的LIBERO-Long上达到99.6%，并在使用双手夹爪和灵巧手的真实世界任务中优于现有方法。进一步评估表明，我们的结构化潜在推理框架能够泛化至未见场景，并支持长时程操作任务。

Authors: Jiaming Liu, Xinghao Zhu, Yiming Zhang, Shanghang Zhang, Yinxi Wang, Yichu Yang, Zhuoyang Liu, Dantong Niu, Soha Pouya, Juekun Li, Yan Chang

CoopUQ: Robust Multi-Robot Social Navigation via Uncertainty-Aware Cooperative Forecasting RLRobot

multi-robot social navigation uncertainty-aware occupancy forecasting cooperative spatiotemporal fusion constrained multi-agent reinforcement learning simulation and real-robot

简要说明：CoopUQ 提出了一种多机器人社交导航框架，通过跨机器人不确定性感知的占用预测来引导约束多智能体强化学习策略，在遮挡和分布外场景下提升了安全性。

TLDR: CoopUQ introduces a multi-robot social navigation framework that fuses uncertainty-aware cooperative occupancy forecasts to guide a constrained multi-agent reinforcement learning policy, improving safety in occluded and out-of-distribution scenarios.

Abstract: Reinforcement learning enables mobile robots to make fast and scalable navigation decisions in constrained human-shared environments. However, directly extending single-robot approaches to multi-robot settings often fails to ensure safety and efficiency, especially under occlusions and out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios, where individual robots may overlook potential risks or make inaccurate predictions. Leveraging cooperation effectively for both prediction and navigation remains a major challenge. We propose CoopUQ, a multi-robot social navigation framework that bridges uncertainty-aware cooperative occupancy forecasting and robust decision making. CoopUQ predicts future occupancy grid maps through cross-robot spatiotemporal feature fusion and further leverages forecasts and their uncertainty to guide policy via constrained multi-agent reinforcement learning, where the cost penalizes navigation through regions predicted to be occupied or highly uncertain. This design enables the policy to adapt its risk sensitivity under distribution shifts. Experimental results across multiple Unity3D-based simulation environments with both in-distribution and OOD settings, including diverse layouts, pedestrian densities, and rushing behavior, demonstrate improved prediction performance and safety over representative baselines. Real-robot experiments further demonstrate its robustness across various scenes. Our code and videos are available at https://coopuq.github.io/.

摘要（中文）：强化学习使移动机器人在受限的人机共享环境中能够做出快速且可扩展的导航决策。然而，将单机器人方法直接扩展到多机器人场景往往无法确保安全性和效率，尤其是在遮挡和分布外（OOD）情境下，此时单个机器人可能会忽视潜在风险或做出不准确的预测。如何有效利用协作来同时改善预测和导航仍然是一个重大挑战。我们提出了CoopUQ，一个多机器人社交导航框架，该框架将不确定性感知的协同占用预测与稳健决策制定相结合。CoopUQ通过跨机器人的时空特征融合预测未来占用栅格图，并进一步利用预测结果及其不确定性，通过带约束的多智能体强化学习来引导策略，其中代价函数对穿越预测为占用或高度不确定区域的导航行为进行惩罚。这一设计使策略能够在分布偏移下调整其风险敏感度。在多个基于Unity3D的仿真环境中进行的实验，涵盖了分布内和分布外设置，包括多样化的布局、行人密度和急行行为，结果表明，与代表性基线方法相比，所提出的方法在预测性能和安全性能上均有提升。真实机器人实验进一步验证了其在不同场景下的稳健性。我们的代码和视频可在https://coopuq.github.io/获取。

Authors: Zehao Wang, Jianpeng Yao, Yuping Wang, Yiping Li, Jiaqi Li, Zhixu Li, Kanghoon Lee, Jinfeng Wang, Cong Liu, Zhaowei Tan, Jinkyoo Park, Jiachen Li

Where is Physical RSI capability from? An Observational Scaling Law of LLM-as-policy Manipulation

Physical Recursive Self-improvement Vision-Language Models Scaling Law Manipulation Observational Scaling

简要说明：本文提出了用于评估VLM机器人操作中物理递归自我改进能力的五轴基准PhysRSI-eval，并提出了物理桶假说。通过观测缩放定律分析从公开能力和早期反馈预测智能体改进，并研究了工作区干预的影响。

TLDR: The paper introduces PhysRSI-eval, a five-axis benchmark for physical recursive self-improvement in VLM-based robotic manipulation, and proposes the Physical Barrel Hypothesis. It analyzes scaling laws predicting agent improvement from public capabilities and early feedback, and studies workspace interventions.

Abstract: In this paper, we systematically investigate the mechanisms, scaling behavior, and generalization of physical Recursive self-improvement. We introduce PhysRSI-eval to quantify physical RSI through a five-axis metric: First-Attempt Performance, Efficiency, Success, Budget and Improvement from failure. Different VLMs are evaluated on 18 manipulation tasks under a fixed interaction budget. The analysis of experimental results motivates the Physical Barrel Hypothesis: different capabilities may constrain different parts of improvement. The five-axis metrics also distinguish systems with close public benchmark averages and show that high scores need not come with early or efficient gains. We study observational scaling from two perspectives: predicting the relative performance of VLM agents from their public capabilities, and forecasting later progress from early physical feedback. Together, these analyses ask how quickly and how far an agent can improve. Moreover, we conduct workspace interventions and then analyze what improvement leaves behind. Removing history reduces late-round success, frozen workspaces remain useful on unseen layouts, and three cross-task cases achieve success earlier. The results suggest that scene-specific adaptation and reusable experience can coexist.

摘要（中文）：在本文中，我们系统性地探讨了物理递归自我改进的机制、缩放行为及其泛化能力。我们引入了PhysRSI-eval，通过五轴指标体系来量化物理RSI：首次尝试表现、效率、成功率、预算及失败中获得的改进。在固定的交互预算下，我们针对18项操作任务评估了不同的视觉语言模型（VLM）。对实验结果的分析引出了“物理桶假说”：不同的能力或许会限制改进过程中的不同环节。五轴指标也能区分那些在公开基准上平均分接近的系统，并表明高分未必伴随着早期或高效的增益。我们从两个角度研究观测缩放：一是根据VLM代理的公开能力预测其相对表现，二是从早期的物理反馈中预测后续进展。这些分析共同探讨了代理能够以多快的速度以及多远程度实现改进。此外，我们进行了工作区干预，并分析了改进后留下的痕迹。移除历史记录会降低后几轮的成功率，冻结的工作区在未见过的布局上依然有效，且三个跨任务案例更早达到了成功。这些结果表明，针对特定场景的适应与可复用的经验能够共存。

Authors: Zekai Li, Jiayi Yu, Jinlu Zhang, Luyang Niu, Zekun Qi, Jun Zheng, Xuchuan Chen, Dairu Liu, Yintianrun Zhang, He Wang, Li Yi

GPT-6 Astra Is a Native Visuo-Tactile Policy for Contact-Rich Manipulation Manipulation

contact-rich manipulation vision-based tactile sensing in-context learning foundation model closed-loop control

简要说明：本文证明多模态模型 GPT-6 Astra 可以直接解读基于视觉的触觉图像并进行接触丰富的操作，在 UniVTac 和 OpenViTac 模拟任务上成功率超过专家基线。

TLDR: This paper demonstrates that GPT-6 Astra, a multimodal model, can directly interpret vision-based tactile images for contact-rich manipulation, achieving higher success rates than specialist baselines on simulated UniVTac and OpenViTac tasks.

Abstract: Recent advances in multimodal models have enabled GPT-6 Astra to perform robotic manipulation through in-context learning. Yet contact-rich control and tactile perception are often regarded as strengths of specialist policies, leaving open whether Astra can directly understand and use tactile observations. We provide, to our knowledge, the first demonstration that Astra directly interprets vision-based tactile images and uses their contact cues for manipulation. Tactile RGB images enter through its existing visual interface, enabling few-shot closed-loop control on nineteen simulated UniVTAC and OpenViTac tasks with 210 sampled scene seeds per setting. With visuo-tactile input, Astra achieves mean success rates of 93.8% and 81.8%, exceeding the strongest reported specialist baselines in our comparison by 22.9 and 13.1 percentage points, respectively. Vision-only performance also leads these baselines, reaching 76.3% and 80.6%. Trajectory analysis reveals active probing, cautious grasping, contact-guided alignment, and recovery, alongside difficulties with tangential loading and corrective execution. Our findings challenge the exclusivity of specialist policies in contact-rich manipulation and show that fine-grained vision can partially compensate for missing touch. They also identify vision-based tactile sensing as an interface for scaling contact understanding with foundation models and reveal signs of benchmark saturation. These results motivate joint visual-tactile pretraining, harder contact-rich evaluations, and physical-robot validation.

摘要（中文）：近期多模态模型的进展使得GPT-6 Astra能够通过上下文学习执行机器人操作任务。然而，富含接触的控制与触觉感知通常被视为专家策略系统的优势所在，因此尚不明确Astra是否能够直接理解并利用触觉观测信息。我们首次证明了Astra能够直接解读基于视觉的触觉图像，并利用其中的接触线索进行操控。触觉RGB图像通过其现有的视觉接口输入，从而在19个模拟UniViTAC和OpenViTac任务上实现了少样本闭环控制，每个设置采样210个场景种子。在视觉-触觉联合输入下，Astra的平均成功率达到93.8%和81.8%，分别比我们对比中最强的已报道专家基线高出22.9和13.1个百分点。仅依赖视觉输入的性能也同样优于这些基线，分别达到76.3%和80.6%。轨迹分析揭示了主动探测、谨慎抓取、接触引导的对准以及恢复行为，同时暴露出其在切向载荷和纠错执行方面的困难。我们的研究结果挑战了专家策略在富含接触操作任务中的独占性，并表明细粒度视觉在一定程度上可以弥补触觉信息的缺失。此外，研究还识别出基于视觉的触觉感知可作为扩展基础模型接触理解能力的一种接口，并揭示了基准测试趋于饱和的迹象。这些发现为视觉-触觉联合预训练、更具挑战性的接触丰富评估以及物理机器人验证提供了有力的动机。

Authors: Chen Yang, Linzhe Shi, Hang Zhang, Mu Xu, Jiansheng Fan, Chen Wang

PICA-WAM: Visual Perturbation Invariance via Cross-Appearance Self-Alignment in World Action Models WorldModel

World Action Models visual perturbation invariance self-alignment robustness robotic manipulation

简要说明：PICA-WAM提出了一种基于交叉外观自对齐的自监督训练框架，通过EMA教师网络将扰动观测的动作表示与名义观测对齐，从而提升世界动作模型对任务无关视觉扰动的鲁棒性，并在仿真和真实机器人上取得一致提升。

TLDR: PICA-WAM introduces a self-supervised cross-appearance self-alignment training framework that improves the robustness of World Action Models to task-irrelevant visual perturbations by aligning action representations from perturbed observations to nominal ones via an EMA teacher, showing consistent gains in simulation and on a real robot.

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) jointly predict future video and generate actions, yet remain sensitive to task-irrelevant visual perturbations, i.e., changes in visual appearance that should not affect robot behavior. We identify a gap in conventional WAM training: video prediction encourages representations to preserve appearance information, while action generation does not explicitly enforce invariance to task-irrelevant appearance. Data augmentation exposes WAMs to such perturbations but does not require perturbed and nominal observations to produce consistent action representations, and alignment with external pretrained features does not guarantee the desired invariance. To address this gap, we propose PICA-WAM, a self-supervised training framework that casts perturbation invariance as an auxiliary cross-appearance self-alignment task for WAMs. An exponential-moving-average (EMA) teacher processes the nominal observation to provide a deeper-layer target, while the online WAM processes a perturbed observation and aligns its shallower-layer action representation to this target through a lightweight projection head. Across four strong WAMs evaluated on RoboTwin 2.0, LIBERO-Plus, EBench, and a real robot, PICA-WAM consistently improves robustness under visual perturbations, preserves nominal performance in simulation, and raises the real robot success rate. PICA-WAM further reduces the sensitivity of video features to task-irrelevant appearance and its propagation into actions, as shown by paired layer-wise diagnostics. Code: https://github.com/YudeZou/PICA-WAM-release

摘要（中文）：世界动作模型（WAMs）联合预测未来视频并生成动作，但对任务无关的视觉扰动（即不应影响机器人行为的视觉外观变化）仍较为敏感。我们发现了传统WAM训练中的一个不足：视频预测促使表征保留外观信息，而动作生成并未明确强制对任务无关外观的不变性。数据增强使WAMs暴露于此类扰动，但并未要求扰动观测与标称观测产生一致的动作表征，且与外部预训练特征的对齐也无法保证所期望的不变性。为解决这一问题，我们提出了PICA-WAM，一种自监督训练框架，将扰动不变性作为WAMs的辅助跨外观自对齐任务。指数移动平均（EMA）教师网络处理标称观测以提供深层目标，而在线WAM处理扰动观测，并通过轻量级投影头将其浅层动作表征与该目标对齐。在RoboTwin 2.0、LIBERO-Plus、EBench及真实机器人上评估的四种强WAMs中，PICA-WAM持续提升了视觉扰动下的鲁棒性，保持了仿真中的标称性能，并提高了真实机器人的成功率。成对逐层诊断进一步表明，PICA-WAM降低了视频特征对任务无关外观的敏感性及其向动作的传播。代码：https://github.com/YudeZou/PICA-WAM-release

Authors: Yude Zou, Yifei Yao, Guanbo Jiao, Jianming Ma, Guanjie Zheng, Xing Gao

HandsOn: A Large-Scale Simulation Benchmark for Generalizable Dexterous Manipulation Manipulation

dexterous manipulation simulation benchmark cross-embodiment vision-language-action world-action models

简要说明：本文介绍了一个大规模仿真基准 HandsOn，用于可泛化的灵巧操作，包含66个任务、18,000个人类演示，并评估了包括VLA和世界动作模型在内的多种策略学习方法，其中提示VLM的成功率仅为5.2%。该基准支持跨本体、物体和任务泛化的研究，包括无需目标任务演示的迁移和技能组合。

TLDR: This paper introduces HandsOn, a large-scale simulation benchmark for generalizable dexterous manipulation, featuring 66 tasks, 18,000 human demonstrations, and evaluations of various policy learning methods including VLA and world-action models, with only 5.2% success for a prompted VLM. The benchmark enables the study of cross-embodiment, object, and task generalization in dexterous manipulation, including transfer and skill composition without target task demonstrations.

Abstract: General-purpose manipulation requires reliable behavior across embodiments, objects, and task demands. We introduce HandsOn, a composable simulation platform and benchmark for cross-embodiment dexterous manipulation. It supports five robotic arms, six dexterous hands, and approximately 200 rigid, articulated, and deformable assets in randomized scenes. The benchmark pairs 18,000 curated human demonstrations with 66 human-verified tasks: Core-50 supports demonstration-based learning and execution tests, while Transfer-16 evaluates asset and relation transfer, skill composition, and deformable manipulation without target-task training demonstrations. Qualitative real-robot rollouts illustrate sim-to-real transfer. Across diffusion, vision-language-action, world-action, and prompted VLM-based methods, the best trained multi-task policy achieves 29.1% Core-50 success. Without benchmark finetuning, GPT-6 using move_eef for palm-and-finger control achieves 5.2% on Core-50 and 1.9% on Transfer-16 over 660 trials. Trained-policy stage diagnostics expose failures in contact establishment, action coordination, and maintaining achieved goals, with additional sequencing errors in composed tasks. HandsOn provides a shared basis for investigating manipulation generalization and the limits of reliable physical interaction.

摘要（中文）：通用操作要求在具身、物体和任务需求之间保持可靠的行为表现。我们提出了HandsOn，一个用于跨具身灵巧操作的可组合仿真平台与基准。该平台支持五种机械臂、六种灵巧手，以及在随机化场景中约200种刚性、铰接和可变形资产。该基准将18,000个精心整理的人类演示与66个人工验证任务配对：Core-50支持基于演示的学习和执行测试，而Transfer-16评估资产与关系迁移、技能组合以及无目标任务训练演示的可变形操作。定性真实机器人 rollout 展示了仿真到真实的迁移效果。在扩散模型、视觉-语言-动作模型、世界-动作模型和基于提示的VLM方法中，最佳训练的多任务策略在Core-50上达到29.1%的成功率。在不进行基准微调的情况下，使用move_eef进行手掌-手指控制的GPT-6在660次试验中于Core-50上达到5.2%，在Transfer-16上达到1.9%。训练策略的阶段诊断揭示了接触建立、动作协调和已达成目标维持方面的失败，并在组合任务中出现额外的序列错误。HandsOn为研究操作泛化及可靠物理交互的极限提供了共享基础。

Authors: Tianwei Luo, Yiming He, Hongjin Wu, Ting Pan, Debin Ren, Haorui Guo, Junlin Yang, Yuxin Zuo, Zhehao Kou, Kaisen Yang, Zhuoqun Lai, Yi Ding, Jiale Yu, Yuchen Zhang, Zijie Qiu, Haozhan Li, Ning Ding

DexOAK: Object-Aware Kinematic Retargeting Manipulation

kinematic retargeting contact-consistent object-aware bimanual tasks robot hand

简要说明：DexOAK提出了一种对象感知的运动学重定向框架，能够从人体运动捕捉生成接触一致的机器人手部参考，改善动态重定向并支持硬件数据生成。

TLDR: DexOAK introduces an object-aware kinematic retargeting framework that generates contact-consistent robot hand references from human motion capture, improving dynamic retargeting and enabling hardware data generation.

Abstract: We introduce DexOAK, a learning-based object-aware kinematic retargeting framework for generating contact-consistent robot hand references from human motion-capture data. DexOAK first minimizes an interaction-graph Laplacian objective over a joint hand-object graph, so the robot reproduces the demonstrated object-relative interaction geometry rather than the human hand pose alone. These per-frame solutions form seed retargeted references, from which a feed-forward network conditioned on human keypoints and object point clouds learns the retargeting function. Object-aware finetuning then refines the network under contact, non-penetration, and self-collision losses that position the fingers on the demonstrated contacts and reduce artifacts destabilizing physics-based refinement. Once trained, the network transfers to unseen data by inference alone, without per-frame optimization. DexOAK references improve dynamic retargeting over the state-of-the-art across bimanual tasks with rigid and articulated objects. On the Inspire hand, success rises from 39.5% to 48.4% on OakInk-v2, and ADD-AUC rises from 62.7% to 77.9% on ARCTIC. Ablations trace the gains to object-aware kinematic retargeting and the amortized network refined with contact losses. Trained on OakInk-v2, it transfers to ARCTIC zero-shot and nears in-domain performance after fine-tuning. On hardware, 46/56 open-loop replays succeed across five tasks, enabling dexterous robot data generation from human data. Visualizations and interactive results are at: https://fspinola.github.io/dexoak/.

摘要（中文）：我们提出了DexOAK，一种基于学习的对象感知运动学重定向框架，用于从人体运动捕捉数据生成接触一致的机器人手部参考。DexOAK首先在联合的手-物图上最小化交互图拉普拉斯目标函数，从而使机器人复现所演示的相对于物体的交互几何结构，而不仅仅是人类手部姿态。这些逐帧解构成种子重定向参考，随后一个以人类关键点和物体点云为条件的前馈网络学习重定向函数。对象感知微调阶段在接触、非穿透和自碰撞损失下优化网络，从而将手指定位于演示接触点上，并减少会破坏基于物理的细化过程稳定性的人为伪影。训练完成后，该网络仅通过推理即可迁移至未见数据，无需逐帧优化。在涉及刚性和关节化物体的双手任务中，DexOAK参考相较现有最优方法显著提升了动态重定向性能。在Inspire手上，OakInk-v2数据集成功率从39.5%提升至48.4%，ARCTIC数据集ADD-AUC从62.7%提升至77.9%。消融实验将上述提升归因于对象感知运动学重定向以及经接触损失优化的分摊网络。该网络在OakInk-v2上训练后，可零样本迁移至ARCTIC，经微调后接近领域内性能。在硬件实验中，五个任务中46/56次开环重放取得成功，实现了从人类数据生成灵巧机器人数据。可视化结果及交互演示详见：https://fspinola.github.io/dexoak/。

Authors: Federica Spinola, Robert Katzschmann, Cordelia Schmid

Tactile In-Hand Object Rotation: A Comparative Study of Hand Morphology in Simulation and Hardware Manipulation

in-hand rotation tactile sensing hand morphology reinforcement learning LEAP Hand

简要说明：本文比较了两种带有触觉传感的LEAP手形态在手中物体旋转任务中的表现，表明完整的触觉反馈和手部几何结构在仿真和硬件中均显著提高了旋转性能和负载分布。

TLDR: This paper compares two LEAP Hand morphologies with tactile sensing for in-hand object rotation, showing that full tactile feedback and hand geometry significantly improve rotation performance and load distribution in both simulation and hardware.

Abstract: Continuous in-hand rotation requires coordinated contact maintenance and renewal, linking manipulation performance to both hand geometry and tactile feedback. We investigate these relationships through rotational progress, finger participation, and fingertip loading on two versions of the low-cost LEAP Hand with anthropomorphic and symmetric finger arrangements. Both hands are integrated with TacTip vision-based tactile sensors and use a shared reinforcement learning framework. Simulation evaluates full tactile, binary touch, and proprioception-only observations on 12 unseen objects; hardware experiments evaluate full tactile policies on ten objects under multiple hand orientations. In simulation, full tactile observations increase mean normalized rotation per episode over proprioception alone by 94.8% for the anthropomorphic hand and 66.9% for the symmetric hand, with longer mean episode durations and lower mean total fingertip loads. Hardware contact measurements reveal more differentiated finger participation in the anthropomorphic hand, while cumulative loading is more evenly distributed across the symmetric hand's fingers. Overall, the symmetric hand achieves a 32.0% higher mean rotation count and a 25.8% higher aggregate rotation rate, together with longer manipulation duration. Additional hardware force recordings show a 19.9% lower mean total fingertip load for this layout. These findings relate finger arrangement to contact organization and load sharing, and show that richer tactile information supports greater task progress at lower mean loading in both simulated embodiments.

摘要（中文）：连续手内旋转需要协调的接触维持与更新，将操作性能与手部几何结构和触觉反馈紧密关联。我们通过旋转进度、手指参与度以及指尖载荷，在低成本LEAP Hand的两种版本上——即拟人化和对称手指布局——研究这些关系。两只手均集成TacTip视觉触觉传感器，并采用共享的强化学习框架。仿真实验评估了12个未见物体上的全触觉、二值触觉及仅本体感觉观测；硬件实验则在多种手部姿态下对十个物体评估全触觉策略。在仿真中，与仅依赖本体感觉相比，全触觉观测使拟人化手的每回合平均归一化旋转量提高94.8%，对称手提高66.9%，同时具有更长的平均回合持续时间和更低的平均总指尖载荷。硬件接触测量显示，拟人化手中手指参与度更具差异性，而对称手各手指间的累积载荷分布更为均匀。总体而言，对称手实现了32.0%更高的平均旋转次数和25.8%更高的总旋转速率，同时操作持续时间更长。额外的硬件力记录显示，该布局的平均总指尖载荷降低了19.9%。这些发现将手指布局与接触组织和载荷分配相关联，并表明在两种仿真具身中，更丰富的触觉信息能够在较低平均载荷下支持更大的任务进展。

Authors: Wenhao He, Max Yang, Chenghua Lu, Yijiong Lin, David A. W. Barton, Nathan F. Lepora

Robot Learning with Vision-Language-Action Models for Agricultural Manipulation VLA

vision-language-action models agricultural manipulation simulation-to-real pretrained policy adaptation generalist robot policies

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于农业抓取任务的仿真到现实的机器人学习框架，通过微调预训练VLA策略（Octo和π0.5），证明π0.5在分布偏移下比Octo更鲁棒。

TLDR: This paper presents a simulation-to-real framework for adapting pretrained VLA policies (Octo and π0.5) to agricultural reaching and grasping, demonstrating that π0.5 outperforms Octo under distribution shifts in both simulated and physical robot experiments.

Abstract: Robotic manipulation in agricultural environments remains challenging due to variations in plant geometry, occlusion, and camera viewpoints. Pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) and generalist robot policies offer a promising approach to addressing these challenges by learning manipulation behaviors from multimodal observations and language instructions. However, adapting these policies to agricultural tasks requires domain-specific demonstrations, which are costly and time-consuming to collect on physical robots. In this work, we develop a simulation-to-real robot-learning framework for agricultural reaching and grasping that integrates task-specific demonstration collection and pretrained policy adaptation. A MuJoCo-based agricultural environment is developed with diverse tomato plant structures to support demonstration collection and controlled evaluation. Expert demonstrations are collected through joystick teleoperation, with a low-level controller used to execute robot actions. Two pretrained generalist robot policies, Octo and $π_{0.5}$, are adapted using simulated demonstrations, followed by further fine-tuning on a physical Franka Research 3 manipulator using real-robot demonstrations. The adapted policies are evaluated under in-distribution, viewpoint/spatial-shift, and out-of-distribution conditions in simulation, followed by physical-robot experiments. The influence of proprioceptive information on policy performance is also investigated. Results show that $π_{0.5}$ achieves higher task-performance scores than Octo and exhibits less degradation under distribution shifts. These findings demonstrate the potential of integrating pretrained generalist policies with task-specific demonstration learning for agricultural manipulation.

摘要（中文）：农业环境中的机器人操作因植物几何形态差异、遮挡以及相机视角变化而依然面临挑战。预训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型及通用机器人策略通过从多模态观测和语言指令中学习操作行为，为应对这些挑战提供了一种有前景的途径。然而，将这些策略适配到农业任务中需要领域特定的示范数据，而在实体机器人上采集此类数据成本高昂且耗时。在本研究中，我们开发了一个面向农业抓取与操作任务的仿真到现实机器人学习框架，整合了任务特定示范采集与预训练策略适配。我们基于MuJoCo构建了一个包含多样化番茄植株结构的农业仿真环境，以支持示范采集和受控评估。专家示范通过摇杆遥操作采集，并使用底层控制器执行机器人动作。两种预训练通用机器人策略Octo和$π_{0.5}$利用仿真示范进行适配，随后在物理Franka Research 3机械臂上结合真实机器人示范进行进一步微调。适配后的策略在仿真环境中分别于分布内、视角/空间偏移及分布外条件下进行评估，随后开展实体机器人实验。此外，还研究了本体感知信息对策略性能的影响。结果表明，$π_{0.5}$在任务性能得分上优于Octo，并且在分布偏移下表现出更小的性能退化。这些发现证明了将预训练通用策略与任务特定示范学习相结合用于农业操作的潜力。

Authors: Hamid Hafezi, Javad Mohammadpour Velni, Mohammadreza Davoodi

RoboValue: A Fine-Grained Sim-and-Real Benchmark for Unified Evaluation of Robotic Value Models Manipulation

robotic value models benchmark manipulation task-state understanding temporal progress

简要说明：RoboValue 是一个用于评估机器人价值模型的新基准，涵盖任务状态理解、时间进度监控、故障与恢复推理以及价值一致性，跨越仿真和真实操作任务。该基准揭示了当前模型在细粒度指令理解和历史依赖进度跟踪等方面的明显不足。

TLDR: RoboValue is a new benchmark for evaluating robotic value models, covering task-state understanding, temporal progress monitoring, failure/recovery reasoning, and value consistency across simulated and real manipulation tasks. The benchmark reveals significant shortcomings in current models, such as weak instruction grounding and history-dependent progress tracking.

Abstract: Robotic value models assess task execution from visual observations and instructions, providing feedback for policy learning and execution monitoring. However, existing evaluations cover only selected aspects of execution understanding, leaving the reliability of value feedback insufficiently tested. We introduce RoboValue, a fine-grained sim-and-real benchmark for unified evaluation of robotic value models. Its framework evaluates four complementary capability dimensions through shared interfaces: task-state understanding, temporal progress monitoring, failure and recovery reasoning, and value consistency. Diagnostic trajectories and instruction variations test whether value judgments accurately reflect task requirements and changes throughout execution. RoboValue-Dataset covers 15 simulation and 20 real-world manipulation tasks, providing expert demonstrations for training and annotated trajectories for fine-grained evaluation. We evaluate representative robotic value models in zero-shot and one-shot settings under standard conditions and separate shifts in robot embodiment and environment. Our results reveal errors in fine-grained instruction grounding, history-dependent progress tracking, and recovery assessment, even in models with strong outcome and forward-progress scores. The same semantic subtask can also receive substantially different value gains across valid execution orders. These findings identify concrete targets for value supervision, while the dataset and public leaderboard support continued assessment of feedback reliability. The website is available at https://robovalue-benchmark.github.io/.

摘要（中文）：机器人价值模型通过视觉观察和指令评估任务执行情况，为策略学习和执行监控提供反馈。然而，现有评估仅覆盖执行理解的若干特定方面，导致价值反馈的可靠性尚未得到充分检验。我们提出RoboValue，一个用于机器人价值模型统一评估的细粒度仿真与真实世界基准测试。其框架通过共享接口评估四个互补的能力维度：任务状态理解、时间进度监控、失败与恢复推理，以及价值一致性。诊断性轨迹和指令变体用于测试价值判断是否准确反映任务要求及执行过程中的变化。RoboValue数据集涵盖15个仿真任务和20个真实世界操作任务，提供专家示范用于训练，并提供带标注的轨迹用于细粒度评估。我们在标准条件下以及机器人具身和环境分别发生偏移的情况下，对代表性机器人价值模型进行了零样本和单样本设置下的评估。结果表明，即使在具有较强结果预测和前向进度评分的模型中，仍存在细粒度指令接地、历史依赖进度跟踪和恢复评估方面的错误。同一语义子任务在不同有效执行顺序下也可能获得显著不同的价值增益。这些发现为价值监督提供了具体目标，同时数据集和公开排行榜支持对反馈可靠性的持续评估。网站地址：https://robovalue-benchmark.github.io/。

Authors: Shengbang Liu, Zhengye Du, Zhilong Wan, Honghao Su, Chenxiang Xia, Chang Ge, Jinyang Xiao, Nan Wang, Zhipeng Hu, Huining Yuan, Shu'ang Yu, Yue Chen, Tianxing Chen, Chuankang Li, Maoqing Yao, Wenbo Ding, Yu Wang, Guanghui Ren, Chao Yu

Learning Wheel Motion Uncertainty for Degeneracy-Aware LiDAR-Inertial Odometry on Quadrupedal Wheel-Legged Robots Locomotion

LiDAR-inertial odometry wheel-legged robot learned uncertainty degeneracy-aware kinematic constraints

简要说明：本文提出一种四足轮腿机器人的紧耦合LiDAR-惯性-运动学里程计框架，通过从本体感觉历史中学习每轮方向相关协方差来处理打滑和接触丢失，并结合退化感知投影抑制不可靠的LiDAR约束，在退化环境中显著降低位置误差。

TLDR: This paper proposes a tightly coupled LiDAR-inertial-kinematic odometry framework for quadrupedal wheel-legged robots that learns per-wheel, direction-dependent covariance from proprioceptive history to handle wheel slip and contact loss, combined with degeneracy-aware projection to suppress unreliable LiDAR constraints, achieving significant position error reduction in degenerate environments.

Abstract: Wheel kinematics can support odometry for quadrupedal wheel-legged robots when LiDAR geometry provides weak motion constraints. However, slip and contact loss make rolling predictions unreliable, and contact state alone cannot determine their reliability across motion directions. We propose a tightly coupled LiDAR-inertial-kinematic odometry framework that retains analytical rolling predictions and learns per-wheel, direction-dependent process covariances from proprioceptive history. The estimator maintains moving wheel-center states, allowing the learned uncertainty to regulate the influence of rolling predictions through forward-kinematic corrections. Degeneracy-aware projection (DAP) complements this mechanism by suppressing LiDAR constraints along geometrically weak directions. The learned covariance network (CovNet) is trained through a differentiable filter using simulated velocity supervision and deployed on the real robot without fine-tuning. On the six room sequences with the highest degeneracy ratios in our indoor dataset, the method reduces mean per-sequence position root mean square error (RMSE) by 66.2% relative to FAST-LIO2 and by 31.0% relative to a fixed-covariance variant. In a severely degenerate corridor run, it achieves an endpoint position error of 0.198 m, compared with 7.531 m for FAST-LIO2. These results demonstrate robust odometry under challenging geometric and wheel-motion conditions. We plan to publicly release our code and multimodal dataset. Project website: https://weihairuo.github.io/wheel-motion-uncertainty/

摘要（中文）：轮式运动学可在激光雷达几何结构提供较弱运动约束时，为四足轮腿机器人的里程计提供支撑。然而，打滑和接触丢失会使滚动预测不可靠，且仅凭接触状态无法判断其在各运动方向上的可信度。我们提出一种紧耦合的激光雷达-惯性-运动学里程计框架，该框架保留了解析滚动预测，并从本体感觉历史中学习每个轮子、方向相关的过程协方差。该估计器维护移动轮心状态，使学习得到的不确定性能够通过正向运动学修正调节滚动预测的影响。退化感知投影（DAP）通过沿几何弱约束方向抑制激光雷达约束，对该机制形成补充。学习得到的协方差网络（CovNet）通过可微分滤波器在仿真速度监督下训练，并无需微调即可部署于真实机器人。在我们室内数据集中退化率最高的六个房间序列上，该方法相比FAST-LIO2将每序列平均位置均方根误差（RMSE）降低了66.2%，相比固定协方差变体降低了31.0%。在一次严重退化的走廊运行中，该方法实现终点位置误差为0.198 m，而FAST-LIO2为7.531 m。这些结果证明了该方法在具有挑战性的几何与轮式运动条件下的鲁棒里程计性能。我们计划公开代码和多模态数据集。项目网站：https://weihairuo.github.io/wheel-motion-uncertainty/

Authors: Hairuo Wei, Yunfan Ren, Renda Yang, Qiangsheng Huang, Zhongyu Li

ReInsVLN: Revisiting Historical Evidence for Training-Free Vision-and-Language Navigation VLN

training-free history compression instruction-guided token selection Vision-and-Language Navigation frozen navigators

简要说明：ReInsVLN 是一个无需训练的框架，通过压缩视觉历史和安排记忆重访来提升视觉语言导航性能，在 R2R 和真实机器人实验中均取得改进。

TLDR: ReInsVLN is a training-free framework that improves vision-and-language navigation by compressing visual history and scheduling memory revisits, showing gains on R2R and real-robot trials.

Abstract: Vision-and-language navigation (VLN) relies on retaining and using relevant observations. Yet growing histories introduce redundancy, and retained information may remain underused. We introduce ReInsBench, a diagnostic benchmark that examines history utilization through controlled continuation trials. Its results show that history-review reinstruction can recover navigation failures using the existing task context. Motivated by this finding, we propose ReInsVLN, a training-free framework supporting memory construction and utilization in frozen navigators. Coverage- and Instruction-Aware Compression constructs compact visual context through temporal redundancy reduction, coverage-aware protection, and instruction-guided token selection. Forgetting-Inspired History Reminders guide navigators to revisit retained observations according to a predefined schedule, without additional model calls. On R2R Val-Unseen, ReInsVLN improves success rates by 8.48 and 3.37 percentage points over the native StreamVLN and InternVLA-N1, reaching 64.27% and 64.44%, respectively. Visual compression largely preserves navigation performance while reducing prefill latency and KV cache memory by up to 21.77% and 32.25%, respectively, on matched observation workloads. Real-world trials on humanoid and quadruped robots further support the applicability of ReInsVLN to sequential instruction following and ordinal navigation.

摘要（中文）：视觉与语言导航（VLN）依赖于对相关观察信息的保留与使用。然而，不断增长的历史数据引入了冗余，且已保留的信息可能未被充分利用。我们提出了ReInsBench，一个通过受控延续试验来检验历史利用情况的诊断基准。其结果表明，基于历史回顾的重新指令可以利用现有任务上下文修复导航失败。受此发现启发，我们提出了ReInsVLN，一个无需训练、支持在冻结导航器中构建和利用记忆的框架。覆盖与指令感知压缩通过时间冗余削减、覆盖感知保护和指令引导的令牌选择构建紧凑的视觉上下文。基于遗忘机制的历史提醒按照预定计划引导导航器重新审视已保留的观察信息，而无需额外的模型调用。在R2R Val-Unseen上，ReInsVLN相较于原生StreamVLN和InternVLA-N1，成功率分别提升了8.48和3.37个百分点，达到64.27%和64.44%。在匹配的观察负载下，视觉压缩在基本保持导航性能的同时，分别将预填充延迟和KV缓存内存降低了最高21.77%和32.25%。在仿人机器人和四足机器人上的真实世界试验进一步支持了ReInsVLN在顺序指令跟随和序列导航中的适用性。

Authors: Siwei Cheng, Hao Wu, Zitong Qi, Xinming Zhang, Haoyu Xi, Peiran Yin, Haozhe Hu, Xudong Wang, Xiaoyu Shen, Wei Zhang

Learn the Task, Not the Schedule: Reducing Spurious Cross-Arm Coupling in Bimanual Imitation Learning Manipulation

bimanual imitation learning temporal recombination spurious cross-arm coupling diffusion policy action chunking with transformers

简要说明：本文提出约束保持的时间重组（CTR），一种训练时数据干预方法，通过重新定时双臂演示片段来减少模仿学习中的虚假跨臂耦合，提高真实机器人成功率和约束满足。

TLDR: This paper proposes Constraint-preserving Temporal Recombination (CTR), a training-time data intervention that retimes bimanual demonstration segments to reduce spurious cross-arm coupling in imitation learning, improving real-robot success rates and constraint satisfaction.

Abstract: A bimanual demonstration specifies both what the robot should do and one particular schedule for when each arm should act. Standard imitation learning does not distinguish task-required cross-arm constraints from incidental scheduling choices, and may therefore exploit opposite-arm progress as a shortcut cue, creating spurious cross-arm coupling even where relative timing is irrelevant for the current task phase. We introduce Constraint-preserving Temporal Recombination (CTR), a training-time data intervention that preserves recorded arm-local sensorimotor content while retiming the corresponding segments to realize admissible schedules that preserve task-required cross-arm constraints. We use CTR to train Diffusion Policy, Action Chunking with Transformers, and $π_{0.5}$, and evaluate them on four simulated and four real-robot tasks. Across six real-robot bimanual progress-state initializations, CTR raises worst-state success from 56% for the strongest non-CTR schedule mixture to 76%. With $π_{0.5}$ on an Independent task, a 4 s pause transfers 2.56 s of delay to the opposite arm under the Concurrent schedule distribution, but only 0.25 s with CTR. On real robots, CTR violates task constraints in only 0--4% of trials, versus 36--98% for narrow-schedule baselines. Code will be released at https://github.com/MINT-SJTU/CTR.

摘要（中文）：双臂示范不仅规定了机器人应执行的任务，还规定了每只手臂应何时行动的特定时间安排。标准模仿学习无法区分任务所要求的跨臂约束与偶然的时间选择，因此可能利用另一只手臂的进度作为捷径线索，即使在当前任务阶段相对时序无关的情况下，也会产生虚假的跨臂耦合。我们提出了约束保持时间重组（CTR），这是一种训练期间的数据干预方法，它在保留记录的臂端本地感觉运动内容的同时，对相应片段进行重新定时，以实现满足任务所要求跨臂约束的可行时间安排。我们使用CTR训练了扩散策略、Transformer动作分块以及\( \pi_{0.5} \)，并在四个模拟任务和四个真实机器人任务上对它们进行了评估。在六种真实机器人双臂进度状态初始化中，CTR将最差状态成功率从最强非CTR时间混合方案的56%提升至76%。在使用\( \pi_{0.5} \)处理独立任务时，在并发时间分布下，4秒的暂停会将2.56秒的延迟转移到另一只手臂，而使用CTR时仅转移0.25秒。在真实机器人上，CTR仅在0%至4%的试验中违反任务约束，而窄时间基线方案的违反率为36%至98%。代码将在 https://github.com/MINT-SJTU/CTR 发布。

Authors: Shuyuan Hu, Deng-Ke Wu, Yifan Jin, Qianhang Luo, Mingchen Ju, Kai Ye, Bo Zhao

SPAR: Structural Pruning and Action Recovery for Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

structural pruning reinforcement learning vision-language-action model compression manipulation

简要说明：SPAR 通过对 VLA 模型的 LLM 骨干进行结构化剪枝并结合强化学习恢复，在极端参数缩减后实现了 1.98 倍加速并提升了 LIBERO 成功率。

TLDR: SPAR introduces structural pruning of the LLM backbone in VLA models combined with RL-based recovery, achieving a 1.98x speedup and improved LIBERO success rates after extreme parameter reduction.

Abstract: The limited onboard computing resources of robots make the inference demands of vision-language-action (VLA) models costly to accommodate. Reducing these demands through aggressive compression, however, can degrade manipulation performance beyond what supervised fine-tuning alone recovers. We present SPAR (Structural Pruning and Action Recovery), which simultaneously prunes the hidden and feed-forward intermediate dimensions of the large language model (LLM) backbone through pruning-aware tuning, then applies reinforcement learning (RL) to recover policy performance. Applied to $π_{0.5}$, SPAR reduces the language backbone from 2.34B to 0.09B parameters and the full model from 3.37B to 1.12B, removing approximately 96% and 67% of their parameters, respectively. At this compression level, RL raises average success across the four LIBERO suites from 84.55% to 93.45%, an 8.90-percentage-point gain. The compressed policy achieves a $1.98\times$ full-policy inference speedup over the unpruned model. These results identify substantial intermediate-dimension redundancy and show that post-pruning RL can recover manipulation performance in compact policies.

摘要（中文）：机器人有限的机载计算资源使得视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的推理需求难以得到满足。然而，通过激进压缩来降低这些需求，可能会使操作性能下降，其程度超出了仅靠监督微调所能恢复的范围。我们提出了SPAR（结构化剪枝与动作恢复）方法，该方法通过剪枝感知调优，同时剪除大型语言模型（LLM）骨干网络中的隐藏维度和前馈中间维度，并随后应用强化学习（RL）来恢复策略性能。将SPAR应用于\( \pi_{0.5} \)后，语言骨干网络参数从23.4亿减少至0.9亿，完整模型参数从33.7亿减少至11.2亿，分别移除了约96%和67%的参数。在此压缩水平下，强化学习将四个LIBERO套件的平均成功率从84.55%提升至93.45%，提升了8.90个百分点。压缩后的策略相较于未剪枝模型实现了\( 1.98\times \)的推理加速。这些结果揭示了显著的中间维度冗余，并表明剪枝后的强化学习能够恢复紧凑策略中的操作性能。

Authors: Shenli Zheng, Zhou Fang, Yuan Du, Yijiang Liu, Li Du

ALIGN: Aligning Condition Estimation and Expression in Advantage-Conditioned Behavior Cloning Manipulation

Advantage-Conditioned Behavior Cloning Vision-Language-Action DiT AdaRMS robot manipulation

简要说明：ALIGN通过直接预测类别成对条件并将其通过AdaRMS调制注入DiT动作专家，改进了优势条件行为克隆在机器人操作中的应用，在混合真实机器人数据集上取得了更高的成功率。

TLDR: ALIGN improves Advantage-Conditioned Behavior Cloning for robot manipulation by directly predicting categorical pairwise conditions and injecting them into a DiT action expert through AdaRMS modulation, achieving higher success rates on mixed real-robot datasets.

Abstract: Human-collected robot manipulation data often mix successful behavior with retries, pauses, recoveries, and failures. Advantage-Conditioned Behavior Cloning (AC-BC) can exploit such mixed-quality data, but only if the conditioning signal is both accurately constructed from offline trajectories and effectively incorporated into the policy's action-vector-field prediction. Existing pipelines can weaken this signal by thresholding estimator-derived advantage scores into noisy conditions, and by routing conditions through prompts that weakly affect the action vector field. We introduce ALIGN, a condition-aligned AC-BC framework for vision-language-action policies. ALIGN directly predicts categorical pairwise conditions in the policy-facing label space and injects them into a DiT action expert through AdaRMS modulation fused with flow time. We evaluate ALIGN on deliberately mixed real-robot datasets for ARX X5 bowl stacking and Franka key hanging, each combining standard demonstrations with retry-heavy trajectories. ALIGN improves condition fidelity, strengthens conditional vector-field separability, and achieves 90.0% and 56.7% closed-loop success, compared with 56.7% and 33.3% for the strongest AC-BC baseline. These results indicate that aligning conditions from estimation to action prediction is an effective way to extract robust manipulation policies from data in which success, recovery and error coexist.

摘要（中文）：人类采集的机器人操作数据常常将成功行为与重试、暂停、恢复及失败混杂在一起。优势条件行为克隆（AC-BC）能够利用这类混合质量的数据，但前提是条件信号既能从离线轨迹中精确构建，又能有效融入策略的动作向量场预测中。现有流程常通过对估计器得出的优势分数设定阈值而生成含噪条件，并将条件经由提示词注入，使其对动作向量场的影响较弱，从而削弱了这一信号。我们提出了ALIGN，一种面向视觉-语言-动作策略的条件对齐AC-BC框架。ALIGN直接在策略面向的标签空间中预测分类成对条件，并通过融合流时间的AdaRMS调制将其注入DiT动作专家模块。我们在刻意构建的混合真实机器人数据集上评估了ALIGN，包括ARX X5叠碗任务和Franka挂钥匙任务，每个数据集均结合了标准示范与重试密集轨迹。ALIGN提升了条件保真度，增强了条件向量场的可分离性，并实现了90.0%和56.7%的闭环成功率，而最强的AC-BC基线分别为56.7%和33.3%。这些结果表明，将条件从估计到动作预测进行对齐，是从成功、恢复与错误共存的数据中提取稳健操作策略的有效途径。

Authors: Zechen Wang, Zhenqi Qiu, Houlong Xiong, Suohang Zhang, Yiyu Ren, Wanting Xu, Hongfei Niu, Chengyang He, Ge Sun, Ran Cheng, Qian Zhu

Cartender: Verifiable Language-Conditioned Driving by Learning the Drives Not Taken AutonomousDriving

Counterfactual Branching scene-language compatibility instruction-conditioned trajectory generation language residual autonomous driving

简要说明：Cartender 通过反事实分支从真实驾驶日志中生成匹配和不匹配的指令-动作对，学习场景-语言兼容性分数以在遵守场景约束的同时根据语言调节轨迹生成。它在 WOD-E2E 基准上提高了指令跟随性能并减少了不可行指令的执行。

TLDR: Cartender introduces Counterfactual Branching to create matched and mismatched instruction-action pairs from real driving logs, learning a scene-language compatibility score to condition trajectory generation on language while respecting scene constraints. It improves instruction-following performance and reduces infeasible-instruction execution on the WOD-E2E benchmark.

Abstract: Every driving scene is logged once, but driving is one-to-many: the scene determines which behaviors are feasible, while an instruction selects among them. A log records only the action taken, leaving no direct supervision for alternative feasible actions or instructions the scene cannot support. Consequently, a policy that ignores language and one that follows it without regard to scene constraints can fit the same data. We present Cartender, which learns from the drives not taken. Counterfactual Branching constructs matched and mismatched instruction-action pairs from real recordings without a simulator: a vision-language model proposes alternative futures and their selecting instructions, while unsupported instructions provide negative labels. A learned scene-language compatibility score regulates language conditioning in trajectory generation, and a reward-trained language residual re-ranks generated candidates over a scene-based score. The branches are used for training; instruction following is evaluated by swapping instructions under identical recorded inputs and measuring behavior rather than agreement with generated targets. On WOD-E2E, the best of four proposals achieves an RFS of 8.642 across 3,603 feasible instruction conditions. Across 8,974 admitted proposals, mean RFS is 8.203 versus 7.906 for matched logged trajectories, and 67% score higher than their logged counterpart. Compared with matched-only imitation using the same backbone, Cartender improves same-scene paired instruction success from 23.67% to 57.00% and RFS from 6.32 to 7.10; its gate reduces infeasible-instruction execution from 53.36% to 14.18%.

摘要（中文）：每次驾驶场景仅被记录一次，但驾驶是一对多的关系：场景决定了哪些行为可行，而指令则在这些行为中做出选择。日志仅记录了实际采取的动作，未对替代可行行为或场景无法支持的指令提供直接监督。因此，忽略语言的策略与无视场景约束而执行指令的策略，均可能拟合相同的数据。我们提出了Cartender，该方法从未被执行的驾驶行为中学习。反事实分支构建基于真实录制的匹配与不匹配的指令-动作对，且无需模拟器：视觉语言模型提出替代未来及其选择指令，而不受支持的指令则提供负标签。学习得到的场景-语言兼容性得分用于调节轨迹生成中的语言条件化，奖励训练的语义残差则基于场景得分对生成候选进行重新排序。这些分支用于训练；指令跟随的评估通过在相同录制输入下交换指令并测量行为而非与生成目标的一致性来完成。在WOD-E2E上，四个提案中的最优方案在3，603个可行指令条件下达到8.642的RFS。在8，974个被接受的提案中，平均RFS为8.203，而匹配的已记录轨迹为7.906，67%的提案得分高于其已记录对应项。与使用相同骨干网络的仅匹配模仿相比，Cartender将相同场景配对指令成功率从23.67%提升至57.00%，RFS从6.32提升至7.10；其门控机制将不可行指令的执行率从53.36%降至14.18%。

Authors: Zhiwen Chen, Benjin Zhu, Yan Xie, Jun Ma

Compositional Humanoid Manipulation through Isomorphic Teleoperation and Independent Skill Routing HumanoidEmbodied

humanoid manipulation mixture-of-experts policy isomorphic teleoperation contact skill learning semantic routing

简要说明：本文提出了HS-MoDP，一种语义混合专家策略，用于组合独立演示的人形机器人手臂技能，以及G1Exo，一种用于关节级遥操作的同构外骨骼，提高了Unitree G1机器人上的全身接触操作能力。

TLDR: This paper introduces HS-MoDP, a semantic mixture-of-experts policy for composing separately demonstrated humanoid arm skills, and G1Exo, an isomorphic exoskeleton for joint-level teleoperation, improving whole-body contact manipulation on a Unitree G1 robot.

Abstract: Humanoid manipulation requires reusable arm skills, yet demonstrating every possible skill combination is impractical. We present Humanoid Semantic Mixture-of-Experts Diffusion Policy (HS-MoDP), which composes separately demonstrated arm skills through independent semantic routing over a shared expert pool. This design preserves arm-specific skill control while sharing action-generation parameters across arms. A semantic scheduler integrates the learned policy with an existing locomotion controller through alternating manipulation and repositioning stages, extending the effective workspace and enabling skill reuse across location changes. To acquire demonstrations of whole-body contact manipulation, we develop G1Exo, an isomorphic exoskeleton that provides direct joint-level control of arm configurations. Experiments on a Unitree G1 show stronger skill composition than the baselines. G1Exo enables more reliable contact teleoperation than end-effector VR-IK, and its demonstrations improve contact-skill learning across four policy architectures. For HS-MoDP, switching from VR-IK to G1Exo demonstrations raises full cabinet workflow success from 35% to 65%. All project hardware designs and source code will be released as open source after the review process.

摘要（中文）：人形操控需要可复用的手臂技能，然而对所有可能的技能组合进行演示是不切实际的。我们提出了人形语义混合专家扩散策略（HS-MoDP），该策略通过共享专家池上的独立语义路由，将分别演示的手臂技能进行组合。这种设计在跨手臂共享动作生成参数的同时，保留了手臂特有的技能控制。一个语义调度器通过交替进行操控和重新定位阶段，将学习到的策略与现有的运动控制器集成，从而扩展了有效工作空间，并实现了技能在位置变化间的复用。为了获取全身接触操控的演示数据，我们开发了G1Exo，一种同构外骨骼，能够对手臂构型提供直接的关节级控制。在Unitree G1上的实验表明，其技能组合能力强于基线方法。G1Exo相比末端执行器VR-IK能够实现更可靠的接触遥操作，其演示数据在四种策略架构上均提升了接触技能的学习效果。对于HS-MoDP，从VR-IK切换至G1Exo演示数据后，完整橱柜工作流程的成功率从35%提升至65%。所有项目硬件设计和源代码将在评审过程结束后开源发布。

Authors: Yiming Wang, Peixian Yang, Lifeng Zhuo, Lai Wei, Xinling Du, Kun Song, Weiming Wang, Daolin Ma

Replan for Error Recovery: Training Embodied VLMs through Verifiable Interaction with Action-Grouped Turn-GSPO Manipulation

Embodied VLM Online reinforcement learning Error recovery Manipulation benchmark Action-grouped advantage estimation

简要说明：本文提出用于具身重规划恢复的仿真环境ERR-Env，以及结合动作分组优势估计的在线强化学习方法AGT-GSPO，训练了一个紧凑型2B参数具身VLM（ERR-VLM），在操作基准上提升了错误恢复能力和任务完成率。

TLDR: This paper introduces ERR-Env, a simulation environment for embodied replanning-for-recovery tasks, and AGT-GSPO, an online RL method with action-grouped advantage estimation, to train a compact 2B embodied VLM (ERR-VLM) that improves error recovery and task completion in manipulation benchmarks.

Abstract: Embodied VLMs can execute increasingly complex manipulation tasks, yet execution errors can leave the environment in states that require replanning for recovery. Existing recovery methods either rely on inference-time mechanisms with fixed policies or learn from failure examples and reference corrections rather than verified action outcomes. To enable recovery learning through verifiable interaction, we introduce the Embodied Replanning for Recovery Environment (ERR-Env), which provides feedback on task progress and execution errors. We further construct ERR-Bench, a benchmark with held-out tasks spanning nominal, intermediate, and error states for evaluating recovery capability and execution reliability. We then propose Action-Grouped Turn-GSPO (AGT-GSPO), an online reinforcement learning method combining turn-level rewards for task progress and error states with action-grouped advantage estimation, and use it to train ERR-VLM, a compact 2B embodied VLM. Evaluation on ERR-Bench reveals a mismatch between task progress and execution reliability across diverse VLMs. AGT-GSPO improves ERR-VLM by 10.25 percentage points in Strict Success Rate for error-free completion and 22.95 percentage points in Recovery Rate, while ablations and zero-shot transfer further validate the effectiveness of our method.

摘要（中文）：具身视觉语言模型（VLMs）能够执行日益复杂的操作任务，但执行错误可能使环境陷入需要重新规划以恢复的状态。现有的恢复方法要么依赖具有固定策略的推理时机制，要么从失败示例和参考修正中学习，而非基于经过验证的动作结果。为了实现通过可验证交互进行恢复学习，我们引入了具身重规划恢复环境（ERR-Env），该环境提供任务进度和执行错误的反馈。我们进一步构建了ERR-Bench基准，其中包含涵盖正常状态、中间状态和错误状态的保留任务，用于评估恢复能力和执行可靠性。随后，我们提出了动作分组回合级GSPO（AGT-GSPO），一种在线强化学习方法，该方法结合了针对任务进度和错误状态的回合级奖励以及动作分组的优势估计，并使用该方法训练了ERR-VLM，一个紧凑的2B参数具身视觉语言模型。在ERR-Bench上的评估揭示了不同视觉语言模型在任务进度和执行可靠性之间存在不匹配。AGT-GSPO使ERR-VLM在无错误完成的严格成功率上提高了10.25个百分点，在恢复率上提高了22.95个百分点，同时消融实验和零样本迁移进一步验证了我们方法的有效性。

Authors: Zhuoran Wang, Keqing Fan, Yang Li, Jinbo Su, Ke Wang, Sijia Luo, Yuanzheng Tan, Junken Peng, Jing Zhang

OmniInteract: Towards Unified Whole-Body Interaction Control for Dual Humanoids HumanoidEmbodied

whole-body interaction dual humanoids surface-aware retargeting flow-based policy residual policy learning

简要说明：OmniInteract 通过表面感知重定向和可扩展的基于流的交互策略，实现双人形机器人的统一全身交互控制，在交互多样性增长时保持接触界面和运动技能。

TLDR: OmniInteract introduces surface-aware retargeting and a scalable flow-based interaction policy to enable unified whole-body interaction control for dual humanoids, preserving contact interfaces and motor skills as interaction diversity grows.

Abstract: Physical interaction is a key capability for humanoid collaboration, requiring coordinated whole-body motion and precise contact. However, learning diverse dual-humanoid interactions faces two major challenges: (1) human-robot morphological differences disrupt contact interfaces and spatial relationships during retargeting, and (2) jointly learning motor skills and partner coordination makes it difficult to retain control fidelity as interaction diversity grows. In this paper, we propose OmniInteract to address these challenges through surface-aware modeling and scalable residual policy learning. First, we introduce Surface Contact-Aware Retargeting, which leverages dense human-robot surface correspondences to jointly retarget both humanoids, preserving explicit interaction contact interfaces and their near-field geometric context. Second, we propose a Scalable Flow-based Interaction Policy for partner-conditioned residual generation. It factorizes dual-humanoid control into a reusable motor foundation and interaction-specific adaptations: partner-aware experts learn corrections over a frozen whole-body motion prior, while conditional flow matching unifies them in a shared residual action space. This enables scalable skill consolidation while retaining pretrained motor capabilities. Extensive experiments demonstrate that OmniInteract improves retargeting fidelity and dual-humanoid coordination while better retaining interaction performance as skill diversity grows. Real-world deployment further demonstrates successful contact establishment, stable whole-body coordination, and recovery from external perturbations.

摘要（中文）：物理交互是人形机器人协作中的关键能力，要求全身协调运动与精确接触。然而，学习多样化的双人形机器人交互面临两大挑战：（1）人机形态差异在重定向过程中破坏接触界面和空间关系；（2）同时学习运动技能与伙伴协调使得随着交互多样性增长，保持控制保真度变得困难。本文提出OmniInteract框架，通过表面感知建模与可扩展残差策略学习来解决上述挑战。首先，我们引入表面接触感知重定向方法，利用稠密的人-机器人表面对应关系联合重定向两个人形机器人，保留显式交互接触界面及其近场几何上下文。其次，我们提出基于可扩展流匹配的交互策略，用于伙伴条件残差生成。该方法将双人形机器人控制分解为可复用的运动基础模块与交互特异性自适应模块：伙伴感知专家在冻结的全身运动先验之上学习修正量，而条件流匹配在共享残差动作空间中对这些修正量进行统一。这使得技能整合具有可扩展性，同时保持预训练的运动能力。大量实验表明，OmniInteract在提升重定向保真度和双人形机器人协调性的同时，能够随技能多样性增长更好地保持交互性能。实际部署进一步验证了接触建立、稳定全身协调以及对外部扰动的恢复能力。

Authors: Yinghao Li, Tianyu Zhang, Zhuohao Li, Yi-Lin Wei, Fa-Ting Hong, Qing Zhang, Wei-Shi Zheng

PaceVLA: Adaptive Temporal Action Quantization in Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

temporal action quantization Vision-Language-Action model adaptive execution mode action decoders robotic manipulation

简要说明：PaceVLA 提出了一种针对视觉-语言-动作模型的自适应时间动作量化框架，通过结合模式特定动作解码器和量化引导路由，在保持任务成功率的同时加速机器人执行。

TLDR: PaceVLA introduces an adaptive temporal action quantization framework for Vision-Language-Action models, combining mode-specific action decoders with a quantizability-guided router to speed up robot execution while preserving task success across simulation and real-world benchmarks.

Abstract: Fast and reliable manipulation is crucial for practical robot deployment. Although Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently shown remarkable progress as generalist robot policies, their execution often remains temporally inefficient. A key source of this inefficiency is that policies learn fine-grained temporal patterns from teleoperated demonstrations, requiring many low-level action steps. Temporal action quantization offers a simple way to accelerate execution by aggregating consecutive low-level actions into temporally coarser actions. However, applying action quantization without considering when fine-grained control is required introduces a speed-accuracy trade-off: accelerated actions may efficiently reduce redundant steps in some phases, while discarding critical motion details in precision-sensitive interactions. To address this, we propose PaceVLA, a unified framework for adaptive temporal execution in VLAs that integrates two coupled components: (1) mode-specific action decoders built on a shared action expert, supporting multiple temporal granularities and prediction horizons, and (2) a quantizability-guided mode selection scheme which decides whether coarse execution is appropriate, and a context-conditioned router that selects an execution mode at each inference step. Experiments across three multi-task simulation benchmarks and six real-world tasks show that PaceVLA improves execution efficiency while maintaining task success rate across multiple embodiments, including long-horizon and dexterous manipulation.

摘要（中文）：快速且可靠的操作对于机器人的实际部署至关重要。尽管视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型近年来作为通用机器人策略取得了显著进展，但其执行过程在时间上往往仍缺乏效率。这一效率低下的一个关键来源在于，策略从遥操作演示中学习细粒度的时间模式，需要大量低层级的动作步骤。时间动作量化通过将连续的低层级动作聚合为时间上更粗粒度的动作，提供了一种简化的加速执行方式。然而，在不考虑何时需要细粒度控制的情况下应用动作量化，会引入速度与精度之间的权衡：加速动作虽能在某些阶段有效减少冗余步骤，但在精度敏感的交互相中可能会丢失关键的运动细节。为解决这一问题，我们提出了PaceVLA，一个用于VLA自适应时间执行的统一框架，该框架整合了两个耦合组件：（1）基于共享动作专家构建的模式特定动作解码器，支持多种时间粒度和预测范围；（2）一个由可量化性引导的模式选择方案，用于判断粗粒度执行是否合适，以及一个上下文条件路由机制，在每次推理步骤中选择执行模式。在三个多任务仿真基准和六项真实世界任务上的实验表明，PaceVLA在提升执行效率的同时，在多种实施例（包括长时程任务和灵巧操作任务）中保持了任务成功率。

Authors: Hojin Jeon, Jimin Lee, Taekwan Kim, Nayoung Oh, Taeyoung Kim, Myungkyu Koo, Jinmo Koo, Joonwoo Ahn, Jinwoo Shin

Vision-Language-Delta-Action: Learning Compact Deltas as Actionable Transition Interfaces for Robotic Manipulation VLA

Vision-Language-Action world-action model state-change modeling action refinement robotic manipulation

简要说明：VLDA将机器人操作重新定义为视觉语言理解与动作生成之间的紧凑增量预测，减少了完整未来状态建模的负担，并提高了长程一致性和泛化能力。

TLDR: VLDA reformulates robotic manipulation as compact delta prediction between vision-language understanding and action generation, reducing the burden of full future-state modeling and improving long-horizon consistency and generalization.

Abstract: Robotic manipulation is not merely observation-to-action generation, but the realization of task-specified state changes in the physical world. Existing vision-language-action (VLA) methods directly learn observation-to-action mappings, imposing a substantial learning burden due to the gap between semantic understanding and action execution. Although world-action models (WAMs) improve control through future prediction, modeling complete future states wastes capacity on static appearance and action-irrelevant changes. We propose Vision-Language-Delta-Action (VLDA), a paradigm that reformulates full future prediction as compact actionable transition modeling. Its core is a compact Delta variable that captures latent world-state changes, serving as an interface between vision-language understanding and action generation. VLDA learns Delta through a unified objective composed of the Local Transition Filter (LT-Filter) and Global Transition Anchor (GT-Anchor). LT-Filter captures task-relevant manipulation-centric changes while suppressing static reconstruction biases. GT-Anchor provides coarse future-level regularization to preserve the overall direction of state changes. Delta-Driven Action Refinement (DDAR) further grounds Delta in the action manifold and injects it as a structured seed to guide action denoising. We implement VLDA within LoongForge, an open-source training framework for large-scale foundation and embodied models, using its modular and distributed infrastructure for unified two-stage optimization. Experiments show that VLDA improves long-horizon consistency, robustness, and generalization, validating actionable Delta as an alternative to direct action prediction and full future-state modeling.

摘要（中文）：机器人操作并非仅仅是观察到动作的生成，而是物理世界中任务指定状态变化的实现。现有的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）方法直接学习从观察到动作的映射，由于语义理解与动作执行之间的鸿沟，给学习带来了巨大负担。尽管世界-动作模型（WAMs）通过未来预测提升了控制能力，但对完整未来状态的建模会在静态外观和与动作无关的变化上浪费容量。我们提出视觉-语言-增量-动作（VLDA）范式，将完整的未来预测重构为紧凑的可执行状态转移建模。其核心是一个紧凑的Delta变量，用于捕捉潜在世界状态变化，作为视觉-语言理解与动作生成之间的接口。VLDA通过统一目标学习Delta，该目标由局部转移滤波器（LT-Filter）和全局转移锚点（GT-Anchor）组成。LT-Filter捕捉以任务相关、操作为中心的变化，同时抑制静态重建偏差。GT-Anchor提供粗略的未来级正则化，以保持状态变化的整体方向。增量驱动的动作细化（DDAR）进一步将Delta锚定在动作流形中，并注入为结构化种子以引导动作去噪。我们在LoongForge中实现VLDA，这是一个面向大规模基础模型和具身模型的开源训练框架，利用其模块化和分布式基础设施进行统一的两阶段优化。实验表明，VLDA提升了长程一致性、鲁棒性和泛化能力，验证了可执行的Delta可作为直接动作预测和完整未来状态建模的替代方案。

Authors: Lingsen Zhang, Wei Li, Jie He, Henghua Zhang, Kai Mo, Shiyong Li, Yanpeng Wang, Rui Shao

TrajWAM: An Efficient Trajectory-Guided World Action Model for Dynamic Robotic Manipulation Manipulation

world action model dynamic manipulation trajectory prediction distillation video-action inference

简要说明：TrajWAM 提出了一种轨迹引导的世界动作模型，通过预测目标物体运动来调节动作生成，并利用解耦蒸馏实现高效的一步推理，用于动态机器人操作。

TLDR: TrajWAM introduces a trajectory-guided world action model that predicts target-object motion to condition action generation for efficient dynamic robotic manipulation, using decoupled distillation for one-step inference.

Abstract: Dynamic object manipulation requires robots to anticipate target motion while replanning fast enough to avoid executing outdated actions. Existing approaches either rely on fast reactive control without an explicit future target state or encode anticipated motion only implicitly. World Action Models (WAMs) offer a promising alternative by coupling future visual prediction with action generation, but scene-level video objectives may underrepresent target dynamics that are critical for manipulation, while iterative video-action denoising introduces substantial latency. We present TrajWAM, a trajectory-guided world action model for efficient dynamic robotic manipulation. Our key insight is to explicitly ground future visual imagination in predicted target-object motion and use the resulting future representation to condition action generation, while preserving this anticipation pathway after acceleration. Given a short history of object masks, a history-conditioned motion predictor forecasts future masks encoding the target object's trajectory. A lightweight Trajectory ControlNet then steers a pretrained video model toward trajectory-consistent futures. The resulting future representation conditions an action expert to predict executable action chunks. To enable one-step inference without breaking this interface, we introduce a decoupled distillation scheme that combines distribution matching for the video backbone, Trajectory ControlNet realignment, and action rollout distillation to support accurate one-step action prediction conditioned on the compressed future representation. Comprehensive evaluations in simulation and the real world show that TrajWAM achieves state-of-the-art performance on dynamic object manipulation tasks while enabling efficient one-step video-action inference. Project page: https://kevingeng3.github.io/TrajWAM/.

摘要（中文）：动态物体操纵要求机器人在快速重规划的同时预测目标运动，以避免执行过时动作。现有方法要么依赖无显式未来目标状态的快速反应式控制，要么仅隐式编码预期运动。世界动作模型通过将未来视觉预测与动作生成相结合提供了一种有前景的替代方案，但场景级视频目标可能低估了对操纵至关重要的目标动力学信息，而迭代式视频-动作去噪则引入了显著的延迟。我们提出TrajWAM，一种轨迹引导的世界动作模型，用于高效的动态机器人操纵。我们的关键洞察在于将未来视觉想象显式锚定于预测的目标物体运动，并利用所得未来表示来条件化动作生成，同时在加速后保留这一预期通路。给定短历史物体掩码序列，历史条件运动预测器预测未来掩码以编码目标物体轨迹。轻量级轨迹控制网络引导预训练视频模型朝向轨迹一致的未来状态。所得未来表示条件化动作专家以预测可执行的动作块。为实现不破坏该接口的单步推理，我们引入一种解耦蒸馏方案，结合视频骨干网络分布匹配、轨迹控制网络重对齐以及动作展开蒸馏，以支持基于压缩未来表示的条件化精确单步动作预测。在仿真和真实世界中的综合评估表明，TrajWAM在动态物体操纵任务上达到最先进性能，同时实现高效的单步视频-动作推理。项目页面：https://kevingeng3.github.io/TrajWAM/。

Authors: Haohan Geng, Sha Zhang, Weishuo Sun, Guanting Ye, Wenhao Yu, Yuang Xie, Qicheng Zeng, Peng Ye, Jiajun Deng, Jianmin Ji

Think Densely, Act Sparsely: Latent Expert Cognitive Chains for Vision-Language-Action Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

Vision-Language-Action Autonomous Driving Dense World Representations Latent Expert Chains Curriculum Learning

简要说明：本文提出了LECDrive，一种基于VLA的自动驾驶框架，通过注入潜在专家认知链来形成密集的世界表征，在多个驾驶基准上提升了目标感知、状态预测和轨迹规划的性能。

TLDR: This paper proposes LECDrive, a VLA-based autonomous driving framework that injects latent expert cognitive chains to form dense world representations, improving object perception, state prediction, and trajectory planning across driving benchmarks.

Abstract: Autonomous driving fundamentally demands dense understanding of visual, semantic, and geometric information, yet existing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are typically trained with sparse supervision such as language instructions or trajectory signals. This direct mapping from dense visual observations to sparse representations forces the model to compress or even discard critical scene information essential for safe driving. We argue that this limitation does not stem from insufficient model capacity, but from the lack of explicit mechanisms that encourage the formation of dense world representations in the latent space. In this spirit, we propose a novel paradigm for driving intelligence, Think Densely, Act Sparsely, and instantiate it with an efficient and interpretable framework, LECDrive (Latent Expert Cognitive Chains for Vision-Language-Action autonomous Driving). The core idea is to mimic the hierarchical perception process of humans by embedding a progressive chain of latent expert cognition within the VLA model. Concretely, we inject a compact set of task-specific latent tokens as carriers, enabling the model to internalize dense knowledge from foundational vision models, including visual representations (DINOv3), semantic structures (SAM3), and spatial geometry (DepthAnything3), while maintaining efficient inference. This interdependent cognitive chain follows a curriculum learning principle, where supervision is progressively structured from representation to semantics and geometry. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LECDrive consistently improves the performance of base VLMs across multiple autonomous driving benchmarks, covering key tasks such as object perception, state prediction, and trajectory planning. These findings suggest that constructing dense world models through structured latent expert chains is a promising direction for VLA-based autonomous driving.

摘要（中文）：自动驾驶从根本上要求对视觉、语义和几何信息进行密集理解，然而现有的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通常仅以语言指令或轨迹信号等稀疏监督进行训练。这种从密集视觉观测到稀疏表示的直接映射，迫使模型压缩甚至丢弃对安全驾驶至关重要的场景信息。我们认为，这一局限并非源于模型容量不足，而是在潜在空间中缺乏显式机制来促进密集世界表征的形成。基于此，我们提出了一种全新的驾驶智能范式——“密集思考，稀疏行动”，并以高效且可解释的框架LECDrive（用于视觉-语言-动作自动驾驶的潜在专家认知链）对其加以实现。其核心思想是通过在VLA模型内嵌入渐进式的潜在专家认知链，模拟人类的分层感知过程。具体而言，我们注入一组紧凑的任务特定潜在令牌作为载体，使模型能够内化来自基础视觉模型的密集知识，包括视觉表征（DINOv3）、语义结构（SAM3）和空间几何（DepthAnything3），同时保持高效的推理性能。这种相互关联的认知链遵循课程学习原则，监督信号从表征到语义再到几何逐步结构化。大量实验表明，LECDrive在多个自动驾驶基准上持续提升了基础视觉语言模型的性能，覆盖目标感知、状态预测和轨迹规划等关键任务。这些发现表明，通过结构化潜在专家链构建密集世界模型，是基于VLA的自动驾驶的一个有前景的研究方向。
