Authors: Chao Yu, Shu'ang Yu, Hao Lin, Hongzhi Zang, Yuxiang Yan, Chenxi Jiang, Zhen Guo, Chuankang Li, Yihao Chen, Xin Xu, Xu Fu, Jiakai Zhou, Liangzhi Shi, Hongyi Ren, Yiwei Liu, Jing Wu, Yuanqing Wang, Chen Wu, Bo Dai, Chunyu Yang, Hongliang Huang, Shuoyu Yue, Weiqi Yin, Yinuo Chen, Ruihua Chen, Chunyang Zhu, Han Xiao, Yanghao Li, Ruipu Wu, Zhikai Cai, Xiu Chen, Xu Tan, Yuchen Yan, Jialin Zhang, Wen Zeng, Yiming Zhou, Zixiao Huang, Guanghui Ren, Quanlu Zhang, Boxun Li, Maoqing Yao, Yu Wang

Progress-Guided Preference Generation for Aligning Generative Control Policies Manipulation

preference alignment generative policies imitation learning long-horizon manipulation diffusion policies

简要说明：PGPG 是一种无监督偏好对齐框架，通过有序覆盖对齐从自主收集的轨迹中自动生成伪偏好标签，无需人工标注，即可有效微调生成式策略。

TLDR: PGPG is an unsupervised preference alignment framework that automatically generates pseudo-preference labels from autonomous rollouts using ordered coverage alignment with expert demonstrations, enabling effective fine-tuning of generative policies without human annotations.

Abstract: Generative policies have achieved strong performance in imitation learning tasks, but their success is often constrained by the limited availability of expert demonstrations. Although preference-based fine-tuning can leverage suboptimal rollouts to improve performance, existing approaches heavily rely on expensive human annotations. In this work, we introduce Progress-Guided Preference Generation (PGPG), an unsupervised preference alignment framework that eliminates the need for human-in-the-loop supervision. Our method leverages ordered coverage alignment to measure sequential progress relative to a small set of expert demonstrations, enabling the automatic extraction of pseudo-preference labels from autonomously collected rollouts. Furthermore, we introduce key enhancements to improve the reliability of these progress-guided preferences, enabling effective fine-tuning of pretrained generative policies without requiring manually designed reward functions. Extensive experiments across a suite of challenging long-horizon manipulation tasks demonstrate that PGPG outperforms standard supervised fine-tuning baselines. Moreover, our conceptually simple framework is broadly applicable across multiple classes of generative policies, demonstrating strong versatility when integrated with both diffusion and flow-matching policies.

摘要（中文）：生成式策略在模仿学习任务中已展现出强劲性能，但其成功往往受限于专家示范数据的稀缺性。尽管基于偏好的微调可以利用次优轨迹来提升性能，现有方法却严重依赖昂贵的人工标注。在本研究中，我们提出了一种无需人工循环监督的无监督偏好对齐框架——进度引导的偏好生成（PGPG）。该方法利用有序覆盖对齐来衡量相对于少量专家示范的序列进度，从而能够从自主采集的轨迹中自动提取伪偏好标签。此外，我们引入了关键改进以增强这些进度引导偏好的可靠性，使得预训练生成式策略无需人工设计奖励函数即可实现高效微调。在多个具有挑战性的长程操作任务套件上进行的大量实验表明，PGPG 的性能优于标准的监督式微调基线。更重要的是，我们这一概念上简洁的框架广泛适用于多类生成式策略，在与扩散策略和流匹配策略集成时展现出强大的通用性。

Authors: Tung M. Luu, Tri Ton, Duc M. Nguyen, Xuan Thanh Nguyen, Nguyen Gia Binh, Quang Tan Nguyen, Vu Duong, Daniel Sonntag, Duy M. H. Nguyen, Vien Anh Ngo, Chang D. Yoo

Revealing and Bridging the Physical Executability Gap in Vision-Language Navigation VLN

Vision-Language Navigation physical executability traversability alignment group policy optimization risk critic

简要说明：本文揭示了仿真器中宽松接触模型导致的VLN物理可执行性差距，并提出VeSTA框架，通过轨迹相对组策略优化和可穿越性风险评论器将VLN策略与物理可执行且语义有效的轨迹对齐，在仿真和真实机器人上验证。

TLDR: This paper reveals a physical executability gap in VLN evaluation due to permissive contact models in simulators, and proposes VeSTA, a framework combining Trajectory Relative Group Policy Optimization and a Traversability Risk Critic to align VLN policies with physically executable and semantically valid trajectories, validated in simulation and real robots.

Abstract: Continuous vision-and-language navigation (VLN) is typically evaluated by goal-reaching success, assuming it reflects an agent's ability to execute language-grounded behavior. We show that this assumption can fail: permissive contact models in current simulators may mask physically infeasible actions, creating a physical executability gap between semantic competence and embodied realization. To bridge this gap, we introduce Visual-Semantic Traversability Alignment (VeSTA), a framework that aligns VLN policies with physically executable futures. We define visual-semantic traversability as the ability to predict instruction-conditioned trajectories that are semantically valid, geometrically feasible, and physically robust. VeSTA addresses this misalignment through two complementary mechanisms: improving executable support in trajectory generation and risk-aware selection among multimodal futures. Specifically, Trajectory Relative Group Policy Optimization uses strict-contact feedback to reshape the candidate distribution toward executable regions, while the Traversability Risk Critic learns a risk-adjusted scalar utility for candidate-wise future selection. Experiments on R2R and RxR reveal substantial dependence of existing VLN agents on simulator contact semantics. Under strict-contact evaluation, VeSTA substantially reduces collision-induced failures while preserving or improving goal-reaching performance, and controlled real-world robot experiments provide evidence that the learned preference transfers beyond simulation.

摘要（中文）：连续视觉-语言导航（VLN）通常通过目标到达成功率进行评估，其隐含假设是该指标能够反映智能体执行基于语言引导行为的能力。我们发现这一假设可能失效：当前仿真器中宽松的接触模型可能掩盖物理上不可行的动作，从而在语义能力与具身实现之间产生物理可执行性鸿沟。为弥合这一鸿沟，我们提出了视觉-语义可穿越性对齐框架（VeSTA），该框架将VLN策略与物理可执行的未来轨迹相对齐。我们将视觉-语义可穿越性定义为预测满足语义有效、几何可行且物理鲁棒的指令条件轨迹的能力。VeSTA通过两种互补机制解决这一错配问题：在轨迹生成中提升可执行性支持，以及在多模态未来轨迹中进行风险感知选择。具体而言，轨迹相对组策略优化利用严格接触反馈将候选分布重塑至可执行区域，而可穿越性风险评判器则学习一个风险调整的标量效用，用于候选轨迹的逐项未来选择。在R2R和RxR上的实验表明，现有VLN智能体对仿真器接触语义存在显著依赖。在严格接触评估下，VeSTA在保持或提升目标到达性能的同时显著减少了碰撞引发的失败，且受控的真实世界机器人实验提供了证据，表明所学偏好能够超越仿真环境实现迁移。

Authors: Gang He, Zhile Cheng, Kepeng Xu, Zhenyang Liu, Yu-Wing Tai

SpaRV: Sparse Radiance Voxels for Scalable Geometrically Consistent LiDAR-Visual Mapping and Rendering Perception3D

radiance fields LiDAR-visual mapping camera pose optimization geometric consistency robotic mapping

简要说明：SpaRV提出了一种稀疏辐射体素建图方法，结合LiDAR和相机数据为机器人仿真和导航创建几何一致且逼真的地图，并通过子图管理降低内存占用。

TLDR: SpaRV introduces a sparse radiance voxel mapping method that integrates LiDAR and camera data to create geometrically consistent, photorealistic maps for robotic simulation and navigation, with memory-efficient submap handling.

Abstract: Robotic simulation, navigation, and inspection need photorealistic and geometrically accurate maps. Radiance fields achieve photorealism, but building them from robot data raises three challenges. A robot's trajectory serves its task, not reconstruction, so images from few viewpoints leave the geometry under-constrained. Residual errors in camera poses and intrinsics blur the map. The map's GPU memory grows with scene size, which limits its level of detail in large scenes. We present \textbf{SpaRV}, a \textbf{Spa}rse \textbf{R}adiance \textbf{V}oxel map rendered by differentiable ray marching, which lets irregular LiDAR scans supervise it alongside images. LiDAR depth and occupancy anchor the under-constrained geometry, and normal and smoothness regularizers keep it smooth between LiDAR points. To correct camera errors, SpaRV alternates map training with photometric optimization of the camera poses and focal lengths. To bound GPU memory in training and rendering, SpaRV holds one submap at a time at full resolution and the rest at coarser octree levels. Experiments show that SpaRV keeps the geometry consistent away from the captured trajectory and sharpens textures by optimizing the camera parameters. On one 24\,GB GPU, SpaRV reconstructs a university campus captured in 63{,}582 images and simulates other cameras and LiDARs. Our code will be released at \url{https://github.com/hku-mars/SpaRV}.

摘要（中文）：摘要：机器人仿真、导航与检测需要既具有照片级真实感又几何精确的地图。辐射场能够实现照片级真实感，但从机器人数据构建辐射场面临三项挑战。机器人的轨迹服务于其任务而非重建，因此来自少数视角的图像使几何约束不足。相机位姿与内参的残余误差会使地图模糊。地图的GPU内存随场景规模增长，从而限制了大规模场景中的细节水平。我们提出\textbf{SpaRV}——一种通过可微光线步进渲染的\textbf{稀疏}辐射\textbf{体素}地图，它允许不规则的LiDAR扫描与图像共同监督其构建。LiDAR深度与占据信息锚定欠约束的几何，法线与平滑正则化项保持LiDAR点之间的平滑性。为纠正相机误差，SpaRV交替进行地图训练与相机位姿及焦距的光度优化。为在训练和渲染中限制GPU内存，SpaRV每次仅以全分辨率持有一个子地图，其余子地图保持在较粗的八叉树层级。实验表明，SpaRV在远离采集轨迹的区域保持几何一致性，并通过优化相机参数锐化纹理。在一块24\,GB GPU上，SpaRV重建了由63{,}582张图像采集的大学校园，并能仿真其他相机与LiDAR。我们的代码将发布于\url{https://github.com/hku-mars/SpaRV}。

Authors: Jianheng Liu, Yunfei Wan, Fangming Cheng, Xiangyu Hong, Zuhao Zou, Haotian Li, Longji Yin, Chunran Zheng, Jiarong Lin, Fu Zhang

Latent Projection for Latent Planning WorldModel

latent world models planning in latent space Gauss-Markov process uncertainty-aware cost latent projection

简要说明：本文提出一种对潜在世界模型规划的事后修正方法，通过拟合线性高斯-马尔可夫转移来识别并降低噪声潜在方向，从而提高导航任务中的规划成功率。

TLDR: This paper proposes a post-hoc correction to latent world model planning by fitting a linear Gauss-Markov transition to identify and down-weight noisy latent directions, improving planning success in navigation tasks.

Abstract: Latent world models let an agent plan in latent space. The planner searches for an action sequence that minimizes a cost, and that cost is often the $\ell_2$ distance between the predicted terminal latent and the goal latent. The latent, however, is partly noise: the regularizer that prevents collapse during world model training promotes variance in the directions carrying no signal. We show that the same regularizer also supplies the structure to prune that noise in the latent. SIGReg drives the latent marginal to a standard Gaussian at every step, and assuming further that the latent sequence is a Gauss-Markov process, the transition is linear with its covariance pinned by the map itself, $z' \mid z \sim \mathcal{N}(Az,\, I - AA^\top)$. Fitting the state dynamics $A$ therefore yields the covariance at no additional cost, and in its eigenbasis each latent direction carries its own uncertainty. Furthermore, constraining $A$ to be a normal matrix fixes that basis across timesteps, so one eigenbasis measures the uncertainty over an arbitrary number of steps and serves as a stable basis to compute the planning cost on. We then restrict the $\ell_2$ cost to the $k$-dimensional subspace the state dynamics carry forward with the least uncertainty. The correction is post hoc: the encoder, the predictor, the rollout, and the planner are all left untouched, and only a single constrained matrix, $A$, is fit. We evaluate across six environments and show large gains on the 2D navigation tasks, TwoRoom and PointMaze, raising success rate over the plain $\ell_2$ cost by up to $+54.7$ points under a harder planning setting. Code is available at https://github.com/yjang43/lp2.

摘要（中文）：潜在世界模型使智能体能够在潜在空间中进行规划。规划器搜索使成本最小化的动作序列，而该成本通常是预测的终端潜在状态与目标潜在状态之间的$\ell_2$距离。然而，潜在状态中包含了部分噪声：用于防止世界模型训练过程中表征坍缩的正则化器会在无信号的方向上引入方差。我们表明，同一正则化器也为裁剪潜在空间中的此类噪声提供了结构基础。SIGReg将每个时间步的潜在边缘分布驱动为标准高斯分布，并进一步假设潜在序列为高斯-马尔可夫过程，则转移为线性转移，其协方差由映射本身固定，即$z' \mid z \sim \mathcal{N}(Az,\, I - AA^\top)$。因此，拟合状态动力学$A$无需额外成本即可得到协方差，并且在其特征基下，每个潜在方向都带有自身的不确定性。此外，将$A$约束为正交矩阵可使该基在时间步间保持固定，因此一个特征基可度量任意步数上的不确定性，并作为计算规划成本的稳定基。随后，我们将$\ell_2$成本限制在状态动力学以最小不确定性前向传播的$k$维子空间上。该修正为事后处理：编码器、预测器、展开过程和规划器均保持不变，仅需拟合一个受约束的矩阵$A$。我们在六个环境中进行评估，结果显示在二维导航任务TwoRoom和PointMaze上取得了显著提升，在更困难的规划设置下，相比普通$\ell_2$成本的成功率最高提升了$+54.7$个百分点。代码可在https://github.com/yjang43/lp2获取。

Authors: Yoo Sung Jang, Michael Ryoo

Self-Crystallizing Behavior Trees: Amortizing Foundation-Model Reasoning into Deterministic Control for Autonomous Drones Other

Behavior Trees foundation models autonomous drones CMA-ES contextual bandit

简要说明：SCBT将基础模型用作编译器，生成子树并进行优化、验证和结晶为确定性行为树，用于自主无人机，以极少的LLM调用实现高任务成功率。

TLDR: SCBT uses a foundation model as a compiler to generate subtrees that are optimized, validated, and crystallized into deterministic Behavior Trees for autonomous drones, achieving high mission success with minimal LLM calls.

Abstract: Classical robot control, Finite State Machines and Behavior Trees (BTs), is deterministic and inspectable but fixed at design time: it fails on situations its designers did not anticipate. Foundation models can synthesize new control logic at runtime, at a cost in latency and non-determinism hard to accept in safety-critical aerial systems. Existing LLM-driven approaches keep the model in the loop permanently and discard what it produces. We propose Self-Crystallizing Behavior Trees (SCBT), in which the foundation model is a compiler rather than a runtime. When a BT node fails, an LLM proposes a minimal, mission-agnostic subtree patch; CMA-ES tunes its parameters in simulation; a contextual bandit decides whether a stored patch or a new LLM call is worth its cost; and a three-stage admission pipeline (static check, invariant-monitored replays, an empirical margin over the unpatched tree) admits only patches that demonstrably recover. Admitted patches are stored in a fleet library and, once the LLM call rate decays, crystallized into a deterministic BT that no human wrote. We implement SCBT on Microsoft Project AirSim with a schema-constrained LLM pipeline (Gemini 3.1 Pro) and a lockstep simulator. Over three seeds of a 20-episode learning phase with wind-gust and battery failures, SCBT used $11\pm1.4$ LLM calls against 26 for whole-tree regeneration and 22 without a library, with 0.33 calls per episode in the second half. The crystallized trees, 28 and 33 nodes with two patches each, reached $97\pm2\%$ mission success with no learning running, against 12\% for the unpatched tree and 98\% for a hand-coded expert tree, and reproduce decision traces exactly when re-ticked offline. Two negative results: replay admission rejected useful wind recoveries by attributing wind-induced geofence excursions to the patch, and a static-only ablation generalized better to held-out failures.

摘要（中文）：经典机器人控制、有限状态机与行为树（BT）具备确定性与可检查性，但在设计时即固定不变：面对设计者未预见的情形时会失效。基础模型可以在运行时合成新的控制逻辑，但代价是延迟与非确定性，这在安全关键的空中系统中难以接受。已有的基于大语言模型（LLM）的方法将模型永久置于回路中，并丢弃其产出的内容。我们提出自结晶行为树（SCBT），其中基础模型扮演编译器而非运行时角色。当行为树节点失败时，LLM 提议一个最小化且与任务无关的子树补丁；CMA-ES 在仿真中调节其参数；上下文赌博机判断是使用已存储补丁还是重新调用 LLM 更值得其成本；三级准入流水线（静态检查、基于不变量监测的重放、与未修补树相比的经验性裕度）仅接纳能明确恢复任务完成的补丁。通过准入的补丁被存入机队库，一旦 LLM 调用率衰减，即结晶为无人编写过的确定性行为树。我们在微软 Project AirSim 上实现了 SCBT，采用模式约束的 LLM 流水线（Gemini 3.1 Pro）与锁步仿真器。在包含阵风与电池故障的 20 幕学习阶段中，跨越三个随机种子，SCBT 使用 $11\pm1.4$ 次 LLM 调用，而整树再生成方式需要 26 次、无库版本需要 22 次，后半程每幕调用次数为 0.33。结晶后的树分别含 28 与 33 个节点、各含两个补丁，在不运行学习的情况下达到 $97\pm2\%$ 的任务成功率，而未修补的树仅为 12\%，手工编写的专家树为 98\%，且离线重新触发时能精确复现决策轨迹。两项负面结果：重放式准入将风致地理围栏偏移归因于补丁而拒绝了有效的风况恢复；仅静态检查的消融实验在未见的失败情形上泛化效果更好。

Authors: Behnam Moradi

AnyGoal: On World Model Generalization Beyond Expert Rollouts WorldModel

world model compositional generalization goal-shifted prediction planning benchmark

简要说明：本文提出了AnyGoal，一个用于评估世界模型在目标偏移任务上泛化能力的基准和库，揭示了现有模型在熟悉状态和动作因素组合上的失败。

TLDR: This paper introduces AnyGoal, a benchmark and library for evaluating world model generalization to goal-shifted tasks, revealing that current models fail on compositional recombinations of familiar state and action factors.

Abstract: The goal of a world model is to capture the dynamics of an environment. This has the great appeal that it allows agents to plan and simulate a course of actions with the help of a world model. For these uses to be reliable, however, the learned dynamics must behave well beyond the specific state-action combinations observed in expert rollouts. Despite this, the relationship between data coverage, dynamics generalization, and downstream planning performance remains underexplored. We study this relationship through the lens of compositional generalization: can a world model recombine familiar state and action factors into valid dynamics? To answer this, we introduce AnyGoal, a benchmark of goal-shifted task variants built from widely used world-model environments, together with an open-source library. Each task is designed to be within reach of a world model that has learned the underlying dynamics: individual state factors and actions remain within their training support, but their combinations are underrepresented in expert trajectories. Across multiple environments and world model families, we find that current models consistently exhibit failures under these recombinations. By examining dynamics and representation failures across model families, interaction regimes, and evaluation metrics, we study where current world models generalize and where challenges remain for goal-shifted prediction and planning. Together, this framework, benchmark, and analysis provide a basis for evaluating progress toward world models that generalize to new planning tasks.

摘要（中文）：摘要：世界模型的目标在于捕捉环境的动态特性。其巨大的吸引力在于，它能使代理借助世界模型进行规划并模拟一系列行动过程。然而，要使这些用途可靠，所学到的动态规律必须在专家演示中观察到的具体状态-动作组合之外也能良好运作。尽管如此，数据覆盖范围、动态泛化能力与下游规划性能之间的关系仍未得到充分探索。我们通过组合泛化的视角来研究这一关系：世界模型能否将熟悉的状态与动作因素重组为有效的动态规律？为回答此问题，我们引入了AnyGoal基准，这是一个基于广泛使用的世界模型环境构建的目标转移任务变体集合，并配套提供了开源库。每项任务设计为世界模型在学习了潜在动态后均能企及：个体状态因素与动作均保持在训练支持范围内，但其组合在专家轨迹中的代表性不足。在多种环境和世界模型家族中，我们发现当前模型在这些重组情境下始终表现出失效现象。通过跨模型家族、交互机制及评估指标来审视动态与表征层面的失败，我们研究了当前世界模型在何处能够泛化，以及目标转移预测与规划仍面临哪些挑战。综合而言，本框架、基准与分析为评估世界模型向新规划任务泛化的进展提供了基础。

Authors: Heejeong Nam, Divyat Mahajan, Quentin Le Lidec, Randall Balestriero, David Klindt

BetaMem: Learning to Remember a Changing World for Embodied Agents Other

long-term memory embodied agents reinforcement learning memory operations spatial memory

简要说明：BetaMem 提出了一个六层记忆框架，通过双重写入约束和失败驱动的递归自我改进，提升了具身智能体在长时任务中的记忆性能。

TLDR: BetaMem introduces a six-layer memory framework with dual-level write contracts and failure-driven recursive self-improvement, improving long-horizon embodied agent memory performance on benchmarks like M3-Bench-robot and EgoLifeQA.

Abstract: Long-horizon embodied agents face temporal confusion and incomplete or distorted records, recurring errors from fixed memory rules, and growing storage and retrieval costs. We present BetaMem, a framework for building and evolving traceable long-term memory through six linked layers: working, spatial, entity, episodic, experiential, and procedural memory. A dual-level write contract constrains operation executability and source support for content: supervised fine-tuning learns compliant memory operations, while reinforcement learning combines repeated sampling with teacher verification of the original observations to reward complete, accurate records and penalize omissions, distortion, and unsupported content. We formulate failure-driven policy recursive self-improvement through diagnosis along the causal sequence of memory operations and local rule repairs gated by independent replay. Atomic tools frame storage, updates, retrieval, and forgetting as cost-utility allocation under storage and read budgets. Using the open-source Qwen3.5-9B model for memory generation, BetaMem achieves overall scores of 48.08% on M3-Bench-robot, 92.08% on LoCoMo, 72.6% on OpenEQA EM-EQA, and 62.4% on EgoLifeQA, the highest among the listed memory methods under their respective evaluation protocols. Training the model for memory generation raises the contract pass rate from 50.9% to 86.2% while reducing output tokens per stored action by 47.3%. A separate Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct evaluation on EMem-Bench achieves an average success rate of 38.4% and an average error recurrence rate of 24.9%. We perform best among evaluated methods using comparably sized open-source models. Category results show that we have advantages in integrating information across observations, recalling events over long histories, and inferring personal habits.

摘要（中文）：长程具身智能体面临时间混淆、记录不完整或失真、固定记忆规则导致的重复错误，以及持续增长的存储与检索成本。我们提出BetaMem，一个通过六个相互关联的层次构建和演化可溯源长期记忆的框架，这六层分别为：工作记忆、空间记忆、实体记忆、情景记忆、经验记忆和程序记忆。双层写入契约约束操作可执行性和内容来源支持：监督微调学习合规的记忆操作，而强化学习将重复采样与教师对原始观测的验证相结合，奖励完整、准确的记录，惩罚遗漏、扭曲及无来源支持的内容。我们通过沿记忆操作的因果序列进行诊断，以及由独立回放门控的局部规则修复，实现故障驱动的策略递归自我改进。原子工具将存储、更新、检索和遗忘框架化为存储与读取预算约束下的成本-效用分配。使用开源Qwen3.5-9B模型进行记忆生成，BetaMem在M3-Bench-robot上取得48.08%的综合得分，在LoCoMo上为92.08%，在OpenEQA EM-EQA上为72.6%，在EgoLifeQA上为62.4%，在各自的评估协议下均列于所列举记忆方法中的最高水平。对模型进行记忆生成训练使契约通过率从50.9%提升至86.2%，同时每次存储动作的输出令牌数减少47.3%。使用独立的Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct在EMem-Bench上评估，平均成功率达38.4%，平均错误复发率为24.9%。在采用相近规模开源模型的评估方法中，我们表现最优。分类结果显示，我们在跨观测整合信息、长历史事件回忆以及个人习惯推断方面具有优势。

Authors: Mai Liu, He Sun, Siru Zhong, Kerun Chen, Hao Yan, Xiaohui Lv, Shuai Tao, Wulong Liu

A Semantic Knowledge Graph Construction Pipeline for Vehicle Intention Prediction in nuScenes AutonomousDriving

knowledge graph intention prediction nuScenes OWL ego-centric

简要说明：本文介绍了nuScenes意图知识图谱（NIKG），一种基于OWL的语义表示和构建流程，用于以自我为中心的车辆意图上下文，将nuScenes场景实例化为Turtle图，并将与意图相关的三个关系（自我相对运动、空间配置和TTC风险）提升为一等属性。该流程应用于nuScenes mini，生成了包含211,335个三元组的图，并在自我相对运动标签上实现了92.5%的前向一致性，为下游任务（如KGE和神经符号推理）提供了一个语义层。

TLDR: This paper introduces the nuScenes Intention Knowledge Graph (NIKG), an OWL-based semantic representation and construction pipeline for ego-centric vehicle intention context, which instantiates nuScenes scenes as Turtle graphs and promotes intention-relevant relations (ego-relative motion, spatial configuration, and TTC risk) to first-class properties. The pipeline, applied to nuScenes mini, produces a graph of 211,335 triples and achieves 92.5% forward consistency for ego-relative motion labels, providing a semantic layer to support downstream tasks like KGE and neuro-symbolic reasoning.

Abstract: Knowledge graphs (KGs) are increasingly used in autonomous driving (AD) to make traffic scene entities and relations explicit for prediction and reasoning. Existing traffic-scene KGs, however, primarily emphasize trajectory forecasting or general scene understanding. This paper presents the nuScenes Intention Knowledge Graph (NIKG), a focused Web Ontology Language (OWL)-based semantic representation and construction pipeline for ego-centric vehicle intention context. NIKG instantiates nuScenes scenes as a self-describing Turtle graph and promotes three intention-relevant relations to first-class properties of each scene participant: ego-relative motion, spatial configuration, and time to collision (TTC) risk. The pipeline uses a small input contract available in many ego-centric driving datasets: ego pose, tracked object annotations, and temporal keyframe order. NIKG is released as an ontology-backed, self-describing graph artifact together with a reproducible construction pipeline and validation protocol for ego-centric intention context. Applying this pipeline to nuScenes mini yields a graph of 211,335 triples across 404 keyframes; under the validation protocol, ego-relative motion labels achieve 92.5% forward consistency. Coverage, semantic consistency, and temporal coherence analyses over this artifact are further reported. NIKG occupies the space between scene-oriented traffic KGs and intention-prediction models: a small, explicit semantic layer intended to support downstream work such as knowledge graph embedding (KGE), SPARQL-based feature extraction, or hybrid neuro-symbolic reasoning.

摘要（中文）：知识图谱（KGs）在自动驾驶（AD）领域中应用日益广泛，用以明确表达交通场景中的实体及其关系，以支持预测与推理。然而，现有的交通场景知识图谱主要侧重于轨迹预测或通用场景理解。本文提出了nuScenes意图知识图谱（NIKG），一种基于Web本体语言（OWL）的聚焦于自我车辆意图上下文的语义表示与构建流程。NIKG将nuScenes场景实例化为自描述Turtle图，并将三种与意图相关的关系统一提升为每个场景参与者的首要属性：自车相对运动、空间构型以及碰撞时间（TTC）风险。该流程仅需多种以自我为中心的驾驶数据集中常用的小型输入契约：自车位姿、跟踪目标标注以及时间关键帧顺序。NIKG作为基于本体的自描述图构件发布，并配有可复现的构建流程及针对自我中心意图上下文的验证协议。将该流程应用于nuScenes mini数据集，生成了包含404个关键帧、211,335条三元组的图；在验证协议下，自车相对运动标签的前向一致性达到92.5%。本文还对该图构件进行了覆盖度、语义一致性和时间一致性分析。NIKG填补了面向场景的交通知识图谱与意图预测模型之间的空白：作为一个简洁、显式的语义层，旨在支持知识图谱嵌入（KGE）、基于SPARQL的特征提取或混合神经符号推理等下游任务。

Authors: Khaled Nowara, Mohamed Manzour, Catherine Elias

PVBench: Quantifying Physical Plausibility in Video Generation with Object-Level Physical Measurements Other

physical plausibility benchmark video generation object-level 6D pose conservation laws embodied agents

简要说明：PVBench 是一个用于量化视频生成中物理合理性的基准，涵盖 46 个维度，利用物体级物理测量，并涉及机器人臂、人形机器人等具身智能体。

TLDR: PVBench is a benchmark for measuring physical plausibility in video generation across 46 dimensions, using object-level physical measurements and including embodied agents like robot arms and humanoids.

Abstract: Recent video generation models produce visually compelling outputs, yet their physical plausibility remains poorly measured. Physical plausibility asks whether generated objects obey geometry, kinematics, dynamics, and conservation laws. Existing benchmarks rely on coarse visual-language model judgments or target embodied world models rather than video generation itself. We introduce PVBench, a physical video benchmark that quantitatively measures the plausibility of generated videos across 46 dimensions organized into seven domains, spanning: i) instruction and semantic fidelity, ii) behavioral and causal consistency, iii) perceptual and temporal quality, iv) geometric and spatial consistency, v) material properties and field states, vi) kinematic and spatiotemporal persistence, vii) and mechanical plausibility with conservation laws. PVBench comprises 600 carefully crafted prompts, of which 30% involve physical embodied agents such as robot arms, humanoids, quadrupeds, and multi-agent systems. For challenging physically tractable dimensions, it pairs each with specialized vision models that derive verifiable, physically grounded measurements, such as object-level 6D pose, metric scale, surface normals, kinematics, and numerical conservation-law residuals. It thus avoids relying solely on subjective scoring, while supporting both text-to-video and image-to-video generation. Finally, we validate the agreement between automatic metrics and human judgments through human evaluation. Meanwhile, we evaluate mainstream open-source and closed-source models and present several insights. By releasing the benchmark, prompts, and calibration protocol, we aim to foster physically grounded video generation.

摘要（中文）：近期推出的视频生成模型能够产生视觉上引人入胜的输出，然而其物理合理性仍未得到充分度量。物理合理性旨在检验生成对象是否符合几何学、运动学、动力学及守恒定律。现有基准要么依赖粗略的视觉-语言模型评判，要么面向具身世界模型而非视频生成本身。为此，我们提出PVBench——一个物理视频基准，从七大领域、46个维度定量衡量生成视频的合理性，涵盖：i)指令与语义保真度，ii)行为与因果一致性，iii)感知与时间质量，iv)几何与空间一致性，v)材料属性与场状态，vi)运动学与时空持续性，vii)以及结合守恒定律的力学合理性。PVBench包含600个精心设计的提示词，其中30%涉及物理具身智能体，如机械臂、人形机器人、四足机器人及多智能体系统。对于具有物理可解性的挑战性维度，每个维度均配以专门的视觉模型，以提取可验证且基于物理的度量，如对象级6D姿态、度量尺度、表面法向量、运动学数据及数值守恒定律残差。因此，该基准不仅避免了完全依赖主观评分，同时支持文本到视频及图像到视频的生成任务。最后，通过人工评估，我们验证了自动指标与人类判断之间的一致性。同时，我们评估了主流的开源与闭源模型，并提出了若干见解。通过发布该基准、提示词及校准协议，我们旨在推动基于物理的视频生成研究。

Authors: Kaiwei Chen, Moran Li, Zhenye Gan, Yabiao Wang, Chengjie Wang, Kexin Zhang, Yong Liu, Jiangning Zhang

Learning Goal-Conditioned Subgoals through Frozen Hierarchical World Models WorldModel

hierarchical world models goal-conditioned subgoals offline training speedup

简要说明：本文提出用轻量级目标条件网络替代分层世界模型中的昂贵搜索，通过冻结的高层预测器训练，在操作和导航基准上实现更快推理和相近成功率。

TLDR: This paper proposes replacing expensive search in hierarchical world models with a lightweight goal-conditioned network trained through a frozen high-level predictor, achieving faster inference and comparable success rates on manipulation and navigation benchmarks.

Abstract: Hierarchical world models plan over long horizons by passing predicted states from a coarse model to a lower-level controller. Choosing these states can be expensive: the upper-level planner repeatedly differentiates through candidate macro-action trajectories. We replace this search with a lightweight goal-conditioned network trained through the frozen high-level predictor. The network supplies a conditioning vector, while the predictor generates the next latent waypoint. Training uses hindsight goals and state-prediction losses on offline trajectories, without search-solution targets or macro-action labels. Inference retains an autoregressive high-level rollout, but requires no high-level candidate optimization. We evaluate this approach on the shared-latent HWM checkpoints distributed with H-JEPA, using three backbone seeds and three head initializations per backbone. With a common evaluation protocol, mean success is 70.4% on Cube, 48.7% on Push-T, 100.0% on FourRoom, and 71.1% on Visual AntMaze. The method improves over the corresponding HWM search baseline on three environments and has the same mean on Push-T. Dedicated measurements on an NVIDIA L40S give 1.28-4.39x end-to-end speedups for batched evaluation. Ablations identify state-adaptive conditioning as a consistent contributor, while predictor-mediated subgoals and unrestricted conditions have environment-dependent benefits.

摘要（中文）：分层世界模型通过将预测状态从粗略模型传递到低层控制器来实现长期规划。选择这些状态可能代价高昂：上层规划器需反复对候选宏动作轨迹进行微分。我们用一个轻量级的目标条件网络替代这一搜索过程，该网络通过冻结的高层预测器进行训练。网络提供条件向量，而预测器生成下一个潜在路径点。训练采用事后目标及离线轨迹上的状态预测损失，无需搜索解目标或宏动作标签。推理阶段保留自回归的高层展开，但无需高层候选优化。我们在与H-JEPA一起发布的共享潜在HWM检查点上评估了该方法，使用三个骨干种子和每个骨干的三个头初始化。在统一评估协议下，Cube上的平均成功率为70.4%，Push-T为48.7%，FourRoom为100.0%，Visual AntMaze为71.1%。该方法在三个环境中优于对应的HWM搜索基线，在Push-T上均值相同。在NVIDIA L40S上的专项测量显示，批量评估的端到端加速比为1.28至4.39倍。消融实验表明，状态自适应条件化是一个稳定的贡献因素，而预测器介导的子目标和无限制条件则在环境依赖性上各有优势。

Authors: Xiang Kaibo, Liu Qingfeng

UBD-Bench: Benchmarking and Analyzing Unimodal Branch Degradation in Multimodal Perception for Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

multimodal perception branch degradation autonomous driving distillation benchmark

简要说明：本文提出了UBD-Bench基准，用于评估自动驾驶多模态感知中的单模态分支退化，并提出了蒸馏干预，既能改善分支性能，也能改善整体模型性能。

TLDR: This paper introduces UBD-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating unimodal branch degradation in multimodal perception for autonomous driving, and proposes a distillation intervention that improves both branch-level and full-model performance.

Abstract: Multimodal perception improves autonomous-driving performance by combining complementary sensor information. However, stronger multimodal predictions do not necessarily imply stronger representations in each modality-specific branch. Such branch-level weaknesses can remain hidden in conventional output-level evaluation. We introduce UBD-Bench, a systematic benchmark for studying unimodal branch degradation (UBD) in multimodal perception. UBD-Bench uses a Paired Frozen-Branch Probe to compare the task-relevant representation quality of the same modality after independent unimodal training and multimodal joint training under matched decoding conditions. Across four autonomous-driving perception tasks and 10 models, we find that Camera branches consistently degrade after multimodal joint training, whereas LiDAR branches exhibit weaker and more model-dependent changes, revealing a pronounced modality asymmetry. Hierarchical probing further shows that Camera-branch degradation extends from the visual backbone through the Camera-to-BEV pathway and is most severe at the pre-fusion Camera BEV representation. Guided by this diagnosis, we introduce unimodal-to-multimodal distillation at the degraded representation. This intervention consistently improves both Camera-branch Probe performance and full-model performance across all four tasks. These results show that multimodal gains can coexist with degraded unimodal representations, highlighting branch-level representation quality as an important dimension for evaluating and improving multimodal perception.

摘要（中文）：多模态感知通过融合互补的传感器信息来提升自动驾驶性能。然而，更强的多模态预测并不必然意味着各个模态专用分支具备更强的表征能力。这类分支层面的弱点在传统的输出级评估中可能难以显现。我们提出了UBD-Bench，一个系统研究多模态感知中单模态分支退化（UBD）的系统性基准。UBD-Bench采用配对冻结分支探针（Paired Frozen-Branch Probe），在匹配解码条件下，对比同一模态经独立单模态训练与多模态联合训练后的任务相关表征质量。在四个自动驾驶感知任务和10个模型上，我们发现相机分支在多模态联合训练后持续退化，而激光雷达分支的变化较弱且更依赖具体模型，呈现出显著的模态不对称性。分层探针分析进一步表明，相机分支的退化从视觉骨干网络延伸至相机到BEV的转换路径，并在融合前的相机BEV表征处最为严重。基于这一诊断结果，我们引入了从单模态到多模态的蒸馏方法作用于退化的表征。该干预措施在全部四个任务中一致地提升了相机分支的探针性能以及整体模型性能。这些结果表明，多模态增益可以与退化的单模态表征共存，凸显了分支级表征质量作为评估和改进多模态感知的重要维度。

Authors: Ang Liu, Xiang Gu, Ruikai Li, Qiyue Wang, Yizhe Fan, Hao Shan, Ziyang Yan, Han Jiang, Zhenning Li, Xiaoshuai Hao, Yilong Ren, Zhiyong Cui, Haiyang Yu

Robotic Physical Comparison of Biologically Motivated and Counterfactual Sensory Arrangements using Biomimetic Skin Other

biomimetic robotic skin tactile sensing sensory arrangement mechanoreceptor analogs counterfactual comparison

简要说明：该论文提出了一种仿生机器人皮肤平台，通过物理实验比较生物学启发与反事实的机械感受器布局在被动触觉任务中的表现，发现类生物布局性能更优。

TLDR: This paper presents a biomimetic robotic skin platform to physically compare biologically motivated and counterfactual mechanoreceptor arrangements across passive tactile tasks, showing that biological-like arrangements perform better.

Abstract: Human skin contains diverse mechanoreceptors, including Merkel cells and Pacinian corpuscles, each localized in specific regions. Although their spatial organization is known to be shaped by molecular signaling and neural induction during development, experimentally examining its functional significance under controlled conditions in living systems remains challenging. In particular, physically comparing alternative receptor arrangements that do not occur biologically is difficult. In this study, we developed a layered biomimetic robotic skin designed to mimic key structural features of human skin tissue by embedding receptor-analog sensors within compliant soft media. Using this platform, we implemented both biologically motivated and counterfactual sensory arrangements and quantitatively evaluated their performance across three passive tactile tasks: detection of weak contacts, a two-point discrimination-like assessment, and texture identification. Arrangements reflecting key features of the biologically motivated sensory organization exhibited higher performance than the alternative configurations examined. This study addresses a biological question concerning how spatial organization influences tactile function by presenting a biomimetic robotic approach that enables physical and empirical comparison of biologically motivated and counterfactual sensory arrangements that are difficult to investigate in living systems.

摘要（中文）：人类皮肤包含多种机械感受器，包括默克尔细胞和环层小体，它们分别定位于特定区域。尽管已知这些感受器的空间组织在发育过程中受分子信号和神经诱导的塑造，但在受控条件下于活体系统中实验检验其功能意义仍然具有挑战性。尤其难以对生物学上不存在的替代性感受器排布进行物理比较。在本研究中，我们开发了一种分层仿生机器人皮肤，通过将类感受器传感器嵌入柔顺软介质中，模拟人体皮肤组织的关键结构特征。利用该平台，我们实现了基于生物学启发的感官排布及反事实感官排布，并在三项被动触觉任务中定量评估其性能：弱接触检测、类似两点辨别能力的评估以及纹理识别。反映生物学启发的感官组织关键特征的排布方式在性能上优于所考察的替代配置。本研究通过提出一种仿生机器人方法，实现了对难以在活体系统中研究的生物学启发排布与反事实感官排布进行物理和实证比较，从而回答了一个关于空间组织如何影响触觉功能的生物学问题。

Authors: Akihiro Miki, Shun Hasegawa, Yoshimoto Ribayashi, Yuta Sahara, Kento Kawaharazuka, Kei Okada

A Probabilistic, Rotation-Preserving Kernel Operator Surrogate for Continuum-Robot Design Spaces Manipulation

operator learning Gaussian process continuum robot uncertainty quantification rotation preservation

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于腱驱动连续体机器人的概率、保旋转的高斯过程算子替代模型，通过神经网络学习的核从设计坐标预测平衡构型并提供不确定性估计，同时实现高效计算。

TLDR: This paper introduces a probabilistic, rotation-preserving Gaussian-process operator surrogate for tendon-driven continuum robots, using a neural-network-learned kernel to predict equilibrium configurations from design coordinates and provide uncertainty estimates with efficient computation.

Abstract: We develop an uncertainty-aware, operator-learning-based surrogate for tendon-driven continuum robots (TDCRs) that generalizes across robot design and actuation while predicting the complete equilibrium configuration. Our central idea is a nonstationary Gaussian-process (GP) kernel whose metric is learned by a shallow neural network from mechanics-aware design coordinates. The network learns how similarity changes across design space, while the resulting kernel defines the design-to-pose operator, its posterior uncertainty, and a criterion for sequential simulator acquisition. We represent backbone position and rotational strain with spatial kernels and reconstruct orientation directly on SO(3), preserving valid material frames and tendon geometry. We use ASkotch with Nystrom preconditioning for scalable kernel operator solves and a separate Nystrom approximation for posterior covariance. Experiments show that kernel-coverage acquisition reduces mean trajectory error by approximately 15% relative to IID sampling, while posterior variance increases for increasingly unsupported designs. Compared with prior neural-operator TDCR models, the method is 30-50% more accurate using approximately 5x fewer training designs while additionally providing posterior uncertainty estimates.

摘要（中文）：我们开发了一种基于不确定性感知、算子学习的新型代理模型，用于肌腱驱动连续体机器人（TDCRs），该模型能够跨机器人设计与驱动条件进行泛化，同时预测完整的平衡构型。我们的核心思想是引入一种非平稳高斯过程（GP）核，其度量由浅层神经网络基于力学感知的设计坐标学习得到。该网络学习相似性如何随设计空间变化，而由此生成的核则定义了从设计到位形的算子、其后验不确定性以及序列模拟器采集的准则。我们使用空间核表示骨干位置与旋转应变，并直接在SO(3)上重构姿态，从而保证材料坐标系和肌腱几何的有效性。我们采用带有Nyström预条件子的ASkotch进行可扩展的核算子求解，并使用独立的Nyström近似计算后验协方差。实验表明，与独立同分布（IID）采样相比，基于核覆盖的采集策略将平均轨迹误差降低了约15%，而对日益缺乏支撑的设计，后验方差则相应增大。与先前的神经算子TDCR模型相比，本方法在训练设计数量减少约5倍的情况下精度提高了30%–50%，同时额外提供了后验不确定性估计。

Learning Geometry-Aware Planning Representations for Monocular Flight with Cross-Modal Supervision Other

cross-modal distillation monocular flight geometry-aware planning MAV navigation 3D Gaussian Splatting

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于微型飞行器单目飞行的几何感知规划框架，通过跨模态蒸馏从深度专家中学习规划相关特征，实现了无需微调即可在真实世界中以高达6.5米/秒的速度避障。

TLDR: This paper proposes a monocular vision-based planning framework for MAV flight that learns geometry-aware features via cross-modal distillation from a depth-based expert, enabling collision avoidance at speeds up to 6.5 m/s in real-world deployment without fine-tuning.

Abstract: Existing high-speed navigation systems for micro aerial vehicles (MAVs) commonly rely on depth cameras, stereo vision, or LiDAR to obtain explicit geometric information, while monocular cameras offer a lighter and lower-cost alternative. However, monocular flight remains challenging because RGB images offer no direct metric cues and visual appearance varies considerably across environments. We propose a geometry-aware monocular visual planning framework that predicts trajectories from two image frames, their relative pose, and the MAV state. Without explicitly reconstructing depth, the proposed method complements the downstream planning objective with feature-level geometric supervision by transferring the planning-relevant representation learned by a privileged depth expert to the RGB planner through cross-modal distillation. The framework first trains a depth-based geometric expert, then distills its planning features into a monocular branch using paired RGB-D observations, and finally adapts the planner to the downstream trajectory planning objective. This design encourages the policy to learn planning-relevant geometric features, enabling collision avoidance. We further use a 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) simulator to render visual observations for data collection, paired RGB-D supervision, and simulation evaluation. The planner trained in simulation is then deployed in real-world environments without real-world fine-tuning, achieving obstacle avoidance at speeds of up to 6.5 m/s.

摘要（中文）：现有微型飞行器（MAVs）的高速导航系统通常依赖深度相机、立体视觉或激光雷达来获取显式几何信息，而单目相机则提供了一种更轻便、更低成本的替代方案。然而，单目飞行仍具挑战性，因为RGB图像无法提供直接的度量线索，且不同环境下的视觉外观差异显著。我们提出了一种几何感知的单目视觉规划框架，该框架从两帧图像、其相对位姿及飞行器状态中预测轨迹。在不显式重建深度的情况下，所提方法通过跨模态蒸馏，将特权深度专家学习到的规划相关表示迁移至RGB规划器，从而以特征级几何监督补充下游规划目标。该框架首先训练基于深度的几何专家，随后利用配对的RGB-D观测将其规划特征蒸馏至单目分支，最后将规划器适配至下游轨迹规划目标。这一设计促使策略学习与规划相关的几何特征，从而实现避障。我们进一步使用3D高斯溅射（3DGS）模拟器渲染视觉观测，用于数据采集、配对RGB-D监督及仿真评估。在仿真中训练得到的规划器无需真实世界微调即可部署至实际环境，实现了最高6.5 m/s速度下的避障能力。

Authors: Wencan Feng, Bailing Tian, Yulin Hui, Zhiyu Li, Junjie Lu

Self-Supervised Inertial Odometry Other

self-supervised learning inertial odometry integration self-supervision pose graph distillation IMU

简要说明：本文提出了一种无需真实轨迹的自监督惯性里程计训练方法，通过积分自监督和位姿图蒸馏，在多种平台上达到接近监督学习的精度。

TLDR: This paper introduces a self-supervised method for training inertial odometry models without ground-truth trajectories, using integration self-supervision and pose graph distillation, achieving near-supervised accuracy across various platforms.

Abstract: Learning inertial odometry for a new platform usually requires ground-truth trajectories. We show that an inertial odometry model can instead be trained from scratch by a myopic teacher that integrates the IMU over each short window independently, a scheme we call integration self-supervision.Interestingly, although supervised only by short-window velocity changes, the student learns to directly predict velocity, and does so more accurately than its integration teacher. Pose graph distillation then refines the model with sequence-consistent targets from a pose graph over many windows. Training on a new platform therefore no longer requires collecting ground-truth trajectories, but only calibrating the IMU and recording data during normal operation. Across six datasets spanning pedestrians, drones, quadrupeds, and a humanoid, the same recipe with no velocity or position labels trains models that come within $0.07$~m/s average velocity error of a same-architecture supervised baseline.

摘要（中文）：为新平台学习惯性里程计通常需要地面实况轨迹。我们证明，惯性里程计模型可以通过一个短视教师从零开始训练，该教师独立地对每个短时间窗口内的IMU数据进行积分，这一方案我们称之为积分自监督。有趣的是，尽管仅通过短窗口速度变化进行监督，学生模型却学会了直接预测速度，并且其预测精度超过了积分教师。随后，位姿图蒸馏通过多个窗口上的位姿图生成序列一致的目标，进一步优化模型。因此，在新平台上训练不再需要收集地面实况轨迹，只需在正常操作期间校准IMU并记录数据即可。跨越行人、无人机、四足机器人和人形机器人六个数据集，相同的配方在无速度或位置标签的情况下，训练出的模型平均速度误差与同架构的有监督基线相差在$0.07$~m/s以内。

Authors: Yuheng Qiu, Yutian Chen, Carlton Cort, Weison Huang, Shibo Zhao, Pieter Abbeel, Rocky Duan, Koushil Sreenath, C. Karen Liu, Carmelo Sferrazza, Junyi Geng, Sebastian Scherer, Guanya Shi

InteractAgent: Agentic Human Motion Interaction with Memory-Augmented Reflection Other

agentic multimodal LLM human-scene interaction closed-loop correction memory-augmented reflection online observation

简要说明：InteractAgent 提出了一种智能多模态LLM系统，通过闭环规划、执行、观察和反思，在UniHSI基准上提高了长期人-场景交互的任务成功率并减少了穿透。

TLDR: InteractAgent introduces an agentic multimodal LLM system that plans, executes, observes, and reflects in a closed loop for long-horizon human-scene interaction, improving task success and reducing penetration on the UniHSI benchmark.

Abstract: Long-horizon human-scene interaction requires coordinated spatial reasoning, physical feasibility, and the ability to recover from compounding execution errors. Text-driven motion models are largely scene-agnostic and lack closed-loop correction, while geometry-conditioned approaches depend on paired scene-motion training or explicit 3D preprocessing that limits generalization to novel layouts and open-vocabulary goals. We present InteractAgent, an agentic multimodal LLM system for long-horizon human-scene interaction that plans, executes, observes, and reflects in a closed loop, using a single MLLM as both planner and evaluator and a frozen MotionLLM as the executor. InteractAgent integrates Online Observation for step-wise recovery decisions (continue/redo/replan) and Memory-Augmented Reflection for multi-round plan refinement with adaptive stopping. On UniHSI, InteractAgent improves task success and reduces penetration compared with training-free baselines. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/InteractAgent.

摘要（中文）：长程人-场景交互要求协调的空间推理、物理可行性以及从复合执行错误中恢复的能力。文本驱动的运动模型大多对场景无关，且缺乏闭环修正能力，而基于几何条件的方法则依赖于配对场景-运动训练或显式3D预处理，这限制了对新布局和开放词汇目标的可泛化性。我们提出了InteractAgent，一个用于长程人-场景交互的智能体多模态大语言模型系统，该系统在闭环中进行规划、执行、观察和反思，使用单一多模态大语言模型（MLLM）作为规划器和评估器，并使用冻结的MotionLLM作为执行器。InteractAgent集成了在线观察以进行逐步恢复决策（继续/重做/重新规划），以及带自适应停止的记忆增强反思，用于多轮计划细化。在UniHSI上，与无需训练的基线方法相比，InteractAgent提高了任务成功率并减少了穿透。代码：https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/InteractAgent。

Authors: Senhe Zhang, Tao Zhang, Yujia Zhang, Zeyu Zhang, Dong Gong

Where Do the Gaussians Go? Foreground Attraction for Camera-Based Weakly Supervised 3D Occupancy Perception3D

3D semantic occupancy weakly supervised sparse Gaussian foreground attraction loss camera-based

简要说明：本文提出了一种仅用于训练的、基于前景吸引的损失函数，用于相机基弱监督三维语义占用模型中的稀疏高斯表示，在不改变推理的情况下提高了前景集中度和IoU。

TLDR: This paper proposes a training-only foreground attraction loss for camera-based weakly supervised 3D semantic occupancy models with sparse Gaussian representations, improving foreground concentration and IoU without changing inference.

Abstract: Camera-based 3D semantic occupancy models can be trained without 3D labels by rendering their predictions into the images and supervising them with 2D pseudo labels. In sparse Gaussian representations trained this way, Gaussian positions are learned only through pixel-wise rendering losses, which we hypothesize give small foreground objects little weight. In trained GaussianFlowOcc models, the Gaussian density on foreground voxels is on average only 1.62 times that on background voxels. We propose a training-only foreground attraction loss that back-projects foreground pseudo-label pixels with pseudo depth and pulls nearby Gaussians toward these 3D points, favoring Gaussians that already predict the target class; the inference network is unchanged. On Occ3D-nuScenes, the loss raises this concentration to 2.40 over three seeds. Over three seeds, the mean foreground IoU increases from 6.29 to 6.96 and is higher for each seed, whereas the change in mean mIoU (13.53 to 13.82) is within the seed-to-seed variation of the baseline. Single-run ablations further indicate that pseudo-label targets outperform targets placed at ground-truth voxels and that acting on the Gaussian positions alone is not sufficient, and a single-seed test shows that the model degrades less when fewer Gaussians are kept at inference.

摘要（中文）：基于相机的三维语义占用模型可以通过将预测结果渲染到图像中，并以二维伪标签进行监督，从而在无需三维标签的情况下完成训练。在这种以稀疏高斯表示进行训练的方式中，高斯位置仅通过逐像素渲染损失来学习，我们假设这种损失对小前景对象赋予的权重较小。在训练好的GaussianFlowOcc模型中，前景体素上的高斯密度平均仅为背景体素上的1.62倍。我们提出了一种仅用于训练的“前景吸引”损失函数，该损失利用伪深度将前景伪标签像素反投影至三维空间，并将邻近的高斯向这些三维点拉近，同时优先选择那些已经预测出目标类别的高斯；推理网络保持不变。在Occ3D-nuScenes数据集上，该损失在三种随机种子下将该集中度提升至2.40。在三种随机种子下，平均前景IoU从6.29提升至6.96，且每种种子下的结果均有所提高，而平均mIoU的变化（13.53至13.82）则处于基线不同种子间的波动范围内。单次运行的消融实验进一步表明，伪标签目标优于置于真实体素处的目标，且仅作用于高斯位置是不够的；同时，单种子测试显示，在推理阶段保留较少高斯时，模型性能下降幅度更小。

Authors: Jeagon Song, Jhonghyun An

Adaptive Bendpoint Formation in Octopus-Inspired Soft Continuum Arms Other

soft continuum arm tendon-actuated inflatable shells adaptive anchoring octopus-inspired

简要说明：本文提出了一种受章鱼启发的软体连续臂，通过可充气外壳在局部增大摩擦、形成临时锚点，实现了自适应弯曲点形成和增强的灵巧性，同时避免了多段多驱动器的机械复杂性。

TLDR: This paper introduces a novel octopus-inspired soft continuum arm with inflatable shells that create temporary anchoring points via friction jamming, enabling adaptive bendpoint formation and enhanced dexterity without mechanical complexity.

Abstract: Octopuses exhibit a powerful form of embodied intelligence from a highly adaptable soft body. One key mechanism is the ability to instantiate bending points at any location along the arm, which enables performant and dexterous behaviours. Taking inspiration from the octopus for its dexterity, this study focuses on changing the curvature of a tendon-actuated arm by adaptively changing the anchoring end-point along the arm. An array of inflatable shells is integrated into the arm, where inflating a shell causes an increase in friction at the location, jamming the tendon and creating a temporary new anchoring point. The novel soft actuator does not break the continuity of the arm between the actuated segment and the loose segment. Experiments show that the actuated segment has a non-constant bell-shaped curvature which is comparable to that of a real octopus arm during a reaching motion. Compared to conventional single-tendon continuum manipulators, the proposed design offers an expanded workspace and enhanced dexterity through the ability to independently shape different regions of the arm through selective curvature tuning. At the same time, it avoids the mechanical complexity typically associated with multi-segment, multi-actuator systems.

摘要（中文）：章鱼展现出一种强大的具身智能，源于其高度适应性的柔软身体。其中一个关键机制是能够沿手臂任意位置形成弯曲点，从而实现高性能、灵巧的行为。本研究受章鱼灵巧性的启发，聚焦于通过自适应改变肌腱驱动臂上的锚定端点来改变其曲率。手臂中集成了一组可充气外壳，充气时会使该位置的摩擦力增大，从而卡住肌腱并形成临时的新锚定点。这种新型软体执行器不会破坏驱动段与松弛段之间手臂的连续性。实验表明，驱动段具有非恒定的钟形曲率，与章鱼手臂在伸展运动中的曲率相当。与传统的单肌腱连续体操纵器相比，所提出的设计通过选择性曲率调节独立塑造手臂不同区域的能力，扩展了工作空间并增强了灵巧性。同时，它避免了多段、多执行器系统通常伴随的机械复杂性。

Authors: Jessica Gumowski, Julian Finn, Krishna Manaswi Digumarti, David Howard

CusADi2: Latency-Optimized Batch Computation of Robot Kinematics, Jacobians, and Hessians on the GPU Other

GPU batch computation kinematics Jacobians Hessians sampling-based control

简要说明：CusADi2 是一个 GPU 软件库，通过在批处理实例内并行化计算，降低了机器人运动学、雅可比矩阵和海森矩阵的批处理评估延迟，在多个基准测试中优于现有框架，并加速了基于采样的控制。

TLDR: CusADi2 is a GPU software library that reduces batch evaluation latency for robot kinematics, Jacobians, and Hessians by parallelizing within each batch instance, outperforming existing frameworks across benchmarks and enabling faster sampling-based control.

Abstract: Trajectory optimization methods, from sampling-based zero-order to gradient-based first- and second-order approaches, require many evaluations of dynamical system functions, i.e., functions derived from a robot's dynamical model, such as forward kinematics and their Jacobians and Hessians. These evaluations are largely independent, e.g., across sampled trajectories or time steps, and can thus be evaluated in parallel as a batch. When used to make decisions online, these methods require low latency, i.e., each batch must complete in as little wall-clock time as possible. Existing frameworks utilize modern GPU hardware primarily to parallelize across batch instances, thereby optimizing throughput but not latency. We present CusADi2, a software library that reduces the batch evaluation latency by additionally parallelizing computation within each batch instance. We benchmark forward kinematics, Jacobians, and Hessians for all 67~robots in the MuJoCo Menagerie, including arms, hands, quadrupeds, humanoids, and biomechanical models, against MuJoCo XLA, MuJoCo Warp, frax, CusADi, and CasADi. CusADi2 achieves lower latency than all baselines at batch sizes of 64 to 4096, while matching them at larger batch sizes. We also demonstrate the performance advantage of CusADi2 in a sampling-based control application. All code is open-source at: https://github.com/johnviljoen/cusadi2

摘要（中文）：轨迹优化方法，从基于采样的零阶方法到基于梯度的二阶方法，都需要对动力系统函数进行大量评估，即从机器人动力学模型中推导出的函数，如前向运动学及其雅可比矩阵和海森矩阵。这些评估在很大程度上是相互独立的，例如，跨采样轨迹或时间步的评估，因此可以作为一个批次并行执行。当这些方法用于在线决策时，需要较低的延迟，即每个批次必须在尽可能短的墙钟时间内完成。现有框架主要利用现代GPU硬件在批次实例之间进行并行化，从而优化吞吐量而非延迟。我们提出了CusADi2，一个软件库，通过在每个批次实例内部进一步并行化计算来减少批次评估延迟。我们针对MuJoCo Menagerie中的全部67个机器人，包括机械臂、灵巧手、四足机器人、人形机器人和生物力学模型，对前向运动学、雅可比矩阵和海森矩阵进行了基准测试，并与MuJoCo XLA、MuJoCo Warp、frax、CusADi和CasADi进行了对比。CusADi2在批次大小为64到4096时实现了比所有基线更低的延迟，在更大批次大小时与它们持平。我们还展示了CusADi2在基于采样的控制应用中的性能优势。所有代码均已开源，地址为：https://github.com/johnviljoen/cusadi2

Authors: John Viljoen, Lasse Peters, Masayoshi Tomizuka, Negar Mehr

Agent World Model in the Wild: Computer-Use Agent Environment Synthesis Other

computer-use agents environment synthesis task synthesis executable environments open-source models

简要说明：本文提出了 WildAWM，一种可扩展的开源流程，用于合成同时支持 GUI、MCP 和 CLI 交互的可控计算机使用环境与任务。在这些合成世界中训练 Qwen 模型，在 8 个分布外计算机使用基准上取得了显著提升。

TLDR: This paper introduces WildAWM, a scalable open-source pipeline for synthesizing controllable computer-use environments and tasks that jointly support GUI, MCP, and CLI interactions. Training Qwen models in these synthetic worlds yields substantial gains on 8 out-of-distribution computer-use benchmarks.

Abstract: Agent learning is shifting from learning from human data toward learning through interaction with the world. However, scaling such learning directly in real-world computer systems is challenging and can introduce substantial security risks. We therefore propose Agent World Model in the Wild (WildAWM), a scalable pipeline for synthesizing controllable environments and tasks for training general computer-use agents (CUAs). Whereas existing approaches typically specialize in a single agent interaction interface, we construct executable environments that jointly support graphical user interfaces, model context protocol services, and command-line interfaces, allowing agents to flexibly combine visual interaction, tool use, and code execution. WildAWM is entirely powered by open-source models, demonstrating that high-quality computer-use environments can be generated without proprietary frontier models. Beyond environments, we address three recurring challenges in task synthesis: ensuring solvability, maintaining sufficient difficulty, and producing reliable verifiers, by introducing execution-based quality gates that combine heterogeneous agent rollouts, cross-judge consistency checks, and counterfactual probes of judgment robustness. The resulting pipeline synthesizes 341 long-horizon environment-task pairs that can require over 100 agent steps to solve and remain challenging even for frontier models, with GPT-6-Astra solving only 60% of them. We train two Qwen models of different sizes exclusively in these synthetic worlds. Both models achieve substantial gains across 8 out-of-distribution benchmarks spanning web, claw, and computer-use agents, demonstrating that learning in WildAWM's synthesized worlds generalizes broadly to unseen computer-use tasks. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/MSR-Orchard/WildAWM.

摘要（中文）：智能体学习正从依赖人类数据转向通过与环境互动进行学习。然而，将这种学习直接扩展到现实世界的计算机系统中颇具挑战性，且可能引入重大安全风险。为此，我们提出“野外智能体世界模型”（WildAWM），一个可扩展的流水线，用于合成可控环境和任务，以训练通用计算机使用智能体（CUA）。现有方法通常专注于单一智能体交互界面，而我们构建的可执行环境同时支持图形用户界面、模型上下文协议服务和命令行界面，使智能体能够灵活组合视觉交互、工具使用和代码执行。WildAWM完全由开源模型驱动，证明无需专有前沿模型即可生成高质量的计算机使用环境。除环境外，我们还针对任务合成中三个反复出现的挑战——确保可解性、维持足够难度以及生成可靠验证器——通过引入基于执行的质检门控机制加以解决，该机制结合了异构智能体展开、交叉评审一致性检查以及判断鲁棒性的反事实探测。由此生成的流水线合成了341个长时程环境-任务对，其中部分任务需超过100步智能体操作才能解决，即便对前沿模型也具挑战性——GPT-6-Astra仅能解决其中60%的任务。我们仅在这些合成世界中训练了两种不同规模的Qwen模型。两个模型在涵盖网页、Claw和计算机使用智能体的8个分布外基准测试中均取得了显著提升，证明在WildAWM合成世界中的学习能够广泛泛化至未见过的计算机使用任务。代码已公开于https://github.com/MSR-Orchard/WildAWM。

Authors: Zhaoyang Wang, Qianhui Wu, Haorui Wang, Simon Yu, Baolin Peng, Canwen Xu, Hao Cheng, Wenlin Yao, Boyi Liu, Yite Wang, Jianfeng Gao, Huaxiu Yao

ActionRoPE: Action as Coordinates for Spatially Consistent Control in Planar-Camera Game World Models WorldModel

action-conditioned world models world-coordinate rotary positions noise scheduling game world models spatially consistent control

简要说明：ActionRoPE 提出了一种无需参数的动作接口，将动作驱动的相机位移转换为世界坐标旋转位置，从而在平面相机游戏世界模型中实现空间一致的动作控制，并利用已知-新结构改进生成的稳定性。

TLDR: ActionRoPE introduces a parameter-free action interface that converts action-driven camera displacement into world-coordinate rotary positions, enabling spatially consistent action control in planar-camera game world models, and a noise scheduling method that leverages the known-new spatial structure to improve generation stability.

Abstract: Game world models have made rapid progress toward real-time interactive generation. Yet action control is still predominantly implemented as feature conditioning, leaving the model to learn from training data how each action should move the visual world. This formulation is poorly matched to a broad class of planar-camera worlds, such as top-down and isometric games. In these worlds, player motion induces a geometrically well-defined planar camera displacement. We observe that the key to spatially consistent control in such worlds is to represent the effect of each action directly in world coordinates. To this end, we introduce ActionRoPE, a parameter-free action interface that converts action-driven camera displacement into world-coordinate rotary positions. As a result, tokens corresponding to the same world location retain the same positional address across time. These world coordinates further expose a spatial asymmetry in generation: regions covered by the initial observation are geometrically known, while newly revealed regions remain to be synthesized. We therefore propose Coordinate-Conditioned Noise Scheduling (CNS), which assigns token-wise denoising schedules according to this known-new structure. It allows observed regions to stabilize earlier, while new content is generated with reference to them. Compared with four representative action-conditioning mechanisms, our approach follows the commanded motion more faithfully and reduces the revisit drift by 66% over the strongest baseline. The same interface transfers across video backbones from 1.3B to 33B parameters and to out-of-distribution scenes. Project Page: https://teawhite.cn/ActionRoPE/.

摘要（中文）：游戏世界模型在实时交互生成方面取得了快速进展。然而，动作控制仍然主要通过特征条件化实现，模型需从训练数据中学习每个动作应如何移动视觉世界。这种表述方式与俯视角和等距游戏等平面相机世界存在明显不匹配。在这些世界中，玩家移动会引发几何上定义明确的平面相机位移。我们观察到，在此类世界中实现空间一致性控制的关键，在于直接在世界坐标系中表示每个动作的效果。为此，我们引入了ActionRoPE，一种无参数的动作接口，将动作驱动的相机位移转换为世界坐标旋转位置。由此，对应同一世界位置的标记在不同时间步保持相同的空间地址。这些世界坐标进一步揭示了生成中的空间不对称性：初始观测覆盖的区域在几何上已知，而新显露的区域则需要合成。因此，我们提出了坐标条件噪声调度（CNS），根据这种已知-新增结构分配逐标记的去噪调度。这使得已观测区域更早稳定，同时新内容以其为参照进行生成。与四种代表性动作条件化机制相比，我们的方法更忠实地遵循指令运动，并将最强基线下的重访漂移减少了66%。同一接口可跨视频骨干网络迁移，从1.3B到33B参数，并适用于分布外场景。项目页面：https://teawhite.cn/ActionRoPE/。
